description:
Do you keep a server in your closet, a homelab in the garage, a VPS in the cloud or perhaps a raspberry pi on your desk at home?

Then this app is for you. With Monitee you will be able to monitor your servers health and get a dashboard like overview of it's key metrics such as CPU usage, available memory and running processes.

Get notified when your server uses too much of your bandwidth, or is running out of disk space. And much more.

If your server runs Docker, you can also manage the containers. Such as start, stop and restart them. And read their logs.

On Linux systems running systemd, you can run systemctl commands to start and stop services. And even read the servuce logs from journalctl.

On Windows, you can manage services and read the event logs.

Currently supported platforms:
- Windows
- MacOS
- Linux
- TrueNAS
- Unraid

This application relies on the open source project monitee-agent. Monitee agent is a self hosted monitoring agent running on your server. It can be downloaded from https://github.com/Krillsson/monitee-agent/releases

Or from the community application catalogs in Unraid and TrueNAS

How to connect Monitee to Sys-API: https://monitee.app/get-started/

name: WorkingHours Time Tracker
description:
Track work hours without turning your day into admin work. WorkingHours is a time tracker, timesheet and personal work log for freelancers, hourly workers, employees, contractors and consultants who need clear records of time, earnings, overtime and billable hours.

Start a work timer, pause for breaks, stop when you are done, or add and edit entries manually. Organize hours by project, task, tag, note and hourly rate so your timesheet is ready when you need to review, export or invoice tracked time.

What you can do with WorkingHours
• Track work time with start, pause and stop timer controls
• Pause and resume breaks, or subtract breaks automatically
• Add, edit and correct manual time entries anytime
• Automatically split work sessions that run across midnight
• Use it as a work hours tracker, work log or time sheet
• Organize entries by tasks, projects, tags and notes
• Track billable hours, hourly rates, fixed fees and earnings
• Keep overtime records for extra hours worked
• Adjust time or earnings with tag rules when needed
• Filter and search entries by task, tag or date
• View charts for time, revenue and productivity patterns
• Export timesheets to Excel or CSV
• Customize export columns and group by day, week, month, task or tag
• Create PDF invoices from tracked time via SubTotal
• Import appointments from your system or Outlook calendar
• Use Pomodoro focus sessions when you want a productivity timer
• Sync across devices with your own cloud storage, if you choose

Built for personal time tracking
WorkingHours works as a freelance time tracker, project time tracker, task timer, invoice time tracker, hours worked calculator, shift tracker or simple time clock for your own workday. It helps you record when you worked, what you worked on and how much time or money each entry represents.

Use the timer like a punch clock, then review totals like a time card calculator when it is time to check work hours, overtime, billable work or project costs.

Android tools for faster tracking
Start and manage your timer from widgets and notifications, use geofencing to start or stop tracking when you arrive at or leave a workplace, and control the timer with NFC tags where supported.

Reports, exports and billing support
Review your work log in clear charts, switch reports between duration and revenue, and filter entries to understand where your time goes. Export your timesheet to Excel or CSV, choose the columns you need, and group entries by day, week, month, task or tag. When you need invoices, SubTotal can create PDF invoices from your WorkingHours data.

Your data, your choice
No WorkingHours account or registration is required for the app itself. Optional sync uses your own cloud storage, including OneDrive, Google Drive, Dropbox, iCloud or WebDAV, so you can keep your work log available across supported Android, Windows, iOS and macOS versions.

That means you can track time on your phone or tablet, then continue reviewing or editing your timesheet on a laptop or desktop through the app's sync model.

Free to use, optional Pro
WorkingHours is free to use. Some advanced features require WorkingHours Pro, which can be tested with a 7-day trial after installing the app.

On Android, Pro removes ads and includes advanced features such as cloud sync, Excel/CSV export, focus sessions, unlimited tasks, widget and notification timer control, and geofencing. Pro is available as either a one-time purchase or a monthly subscription with the same features.

Your Android Pro purchase or subscription is linked to your Google Play account and unlocks Pro for the Android version. Other platforms may require a separate purchase.

DriverLog is the simplest to operate, most complete and most versatile electronic Hours Of Service solution.
DriverLog is both a mobile app that can be installed on any Android device, and is an integrated Fleet management application (can be integrated into 3rd party solutions or our Wireless Links Fleet.Net)

On the server side, DriverLog provides the dispatcher with complete visibility of the status of every driver in the HOS shift and cycle including replay of daily history and comprehensive reports.

To meet different customer requirements and specific system configurations to send data from the ECM to the ELD and then to upload and synchronize the ELD with the server, Driver Log is packaged with multiple hardware solutions that plug into the vehicle ECM and sends the J1939 and J1708 protocols to the ELD via Bluetooth or WIFI, learn more by clicking this link http://www.wlius.com/hos

This is a partial list of the DriverLog functionalities :
• Automatically calculates and displays current and available driving and on duty time in drivers’ shift and cycle.

• Allows editing logs (while recording the edit)
• Alerts the driver of upcoming shift and/or cycle time violations
• Fully integrated with DVIR.
• Automatic driving and stop status detection.
• Automatically uploads to the server via cellular or WIFI every event in real time, so the dispatcher has a complete real time visibility of the drivers’ status within the HOS shift and cycle.
• No data can be lost – the data on the Android device synchronizes real time with the server and is being backed up on the server. In case that the Android device is broken or lost, the driver’s data is downloaded from the server automatically to the new Android device.
• The identical logs displayed on the driver’s Android device are also displayed and printable on the management console.
• DriverLog is fully integrated with Wireless Links Fleet.Net GPS based fleet management system or if you already have a fleet management system DriverLog can be an independent standalone system.
• For integrators DriverLog can be fully integrated into any 3rd party fleet management and/or dispatch application.
• DriverLog has the option to send real time GPS data to a fleet management system, saving the need for a separate GPS unit

name: Drive Hours – Learner Log
description:
Drive Hours – Your Smart Driving Lessons Companion

Drive Hours is a clean and intuitive application created for learner drivers who want to track their driving lessons and monitor progress toward obtaining a driver’s license. The app allows you to log every driving session, keep track of completed hours, and clearly see how close you are to reaching your goal. All information is presented in a simple and readable way, helping you stay organized throughout your driving course.

The application focuses on progress tracking through clear visual indicators and real-time statistics. You can monitor completed driving hours, view remaining time until course completion, and set custom hour requirements for different driving license categories such as B, C, or D. This flexibility makes Drive Hours suitable for various learning paths and individual requirements.

Managing driving sessions is fast and straightforward. Each session can be added using an intuitive date and time picker, allowing you to record both hours and minutes accurately. The full history of driving sessions is always available, and previously saved entries can be edited or deleted if changes are needed. Sessions can also be categorized by license type, making it easy to stay organized even when tracking multiple courses.

Drive Hours provides helpful insights into your driving habits. Weekly activity overviews and calculated averages help you understand your learning patterns and consistency. The app also estimates how many days remain until completion based on your activity, allowing you to plan your lessons more effectively and maintain steady progress.

To keep you motivated, Drive Hours includes an achievement system that rewards progress throughout your course. Milestones such as the first recorded hour, halfway completion, and final achievement help visualize success and encourage regular practice. Achievements are dynamically adapted to your selected license category, giving you a clear sense of advancement.

The design of Drive Hours emphasizes simplicity and modern usability. The interface follows Material Design principles, offering smooth animations, intuitive navigation, and an edge-to-edge layout for an immersive experience. The app supports light mode, dark mode, and system-based themes, ensuring comfortable use in any environment. Its responsive layout adapts well to different screen sizes while remaining easy to use.

The app automatically detects your system language, and you can also change the language manually in the settings at any time. This makes the application accessible to a broader range of users without additional configuration.

Drive Hours is designed for learner drivers preparing for their driving test, students tracking mandatory driving hours, instructors helping learners stay organized, and anyone who wants a clear overview of their driving practice. Unlike complicated tracking tools, Drive Hours focuses on clarity, elegance, and ease of use, making it effortless to log sessions and understand progress at a glance.

Getting started is simple. Choose your driving license category, set your required number of hours, and begin adding driving sessions. As you continue, you can watch your progress grow and unlock achievements along the way.

If you encounter any issues or have suggestions for improvement, support is available through the app settings or by leaving feedback on Google Play.

Download Drive Hours today and take full control of your driving lessons and learning progress.

Work Log was originally created for Android in 2013 and has been continuously added to and improved since then. In 2023 Work Log - Shift Tracker was created from scratch. What is Jolly Phonics?
Jolly Phonics is a programme for teaching reading and writing. It is based on a systematic synthetic phonics approach and was developed by teachers Sue Lloyd and Sara Wernham. It is the first stage in teaching children to read and write using the 5 key skills. It focuses on direct, explicit instruction of phonemic awareness and phonics for both reading (decoding) and writing (encoding). Scientific research has consistently shown phonemic awareness to be essential for building strong reading, spelling and writing skills.

Why Choose Jolly Classroom?
1. Phonics Programme – Bring phonemic awareness to your school with interactive activities and clear instructions

5. Multi-Sensory Learning – Animated guidance, blending & segmenting tools and audio support make learning engaging for all students
6. British & American English Options – Tailor your teaching experience to suit different curriculums

Key Features That Make Learning Effective
1. Phonics Lessons - Step-by-step systematic phonics instruction, including 72 tricky words, helping children learn to read and write confidently
2. Spelling, Grammar & Punctuation - Develop core English skills with structured lessons designed for classroom success
3. Phonics Assessments - built-in phonics assessments that help a school track student progress and prepare effectively for the Phonics Screening Check
4. Interactive Activities - Fun animations and audio support for letter formation, blending and segmenting
5. Progress Tracking - Monitor individual and class performance

Who Is Jolly Classroom For?
1. School – A curriculum-aligned solution for developing reading and writing skills
2. Teachers – A powerful classroom resource for structured phonics and grammar instruction
3. Pupils – Designed for early learners to master phonics, spelling and grammar through interactive lessons
4. Homeschool – An excellent tool for homeschool parents teaching their children at home with a structured, easy-to-follow program

Jolly Classroom is also an excellent resource for English learners, providing a structured and engaging way to build phonemic awareness, reading fluency and English grammar proficiency. With its systematic approach to teaching letter sounds, blending and sentence formation, the app helps English as a Second Language (ESL) students develop confidence in reading and writing. The interactive lessons and audio-supported activities ensure that learners can hear correct pronunciation, practice spelling and improve their understanding of grammar and sentence structure in an accessible way. Whether in a school or a homeschool setting, Jolly Classroom makes mastering English grammar and phonics easy!

Transform Your Classroom Today!
Join thousands of educators using Jolly Classroom to teach phonics, spelling and grammar with confidence.

Download now and bring phonics lessons into your school!

name: Student Gradebook for Teachers
description:
Student Gradebook for Teachers is a secure, offline-first gradebook designed for educators, teachers, and instructors who need a reliable way to manage student records and calculate academic performance. Built to handle complex grading rules entirely on your device, this app streamlines classroom administrative workflows without requiring any internet connection.

Key Features:

Flexible Weighting and Columns
Set up customized evaluations such as assignments, homework, quizzes, midterms, and final exams. Define the maximum possible marks for each evaluation and customize weight configurations (including partial-weight distributions) to match your curriculum requirements.

Excel-Style Grading Formulas
Take control of letter grade assignments using nested IF formulas. You can input customized grade scale thresholds directly into the system to automate letter grade calculations based on your school’s unique grading framework.

Efficient Mark Entry and Fast Grading
Input records quickly using a streamlined interface. The rapid-grade entry mode displays your roster sequentially with specialized sliders, allowing you to quickly save grades for a large student cohort in a single session.

Dynamic Grade Curving
Apply statistical curves directly to classroom marks. Utilize flat boost increments clamped to the total possible weight, or use scaled curving proportional to the highest-scoring student to balance class score distributions automatically.

Detailed Class Analytics
Understand cohort performance instantly with automated statistical visualizations. Access class averages, pass rates, highest and lowest scores, letter grade distributions, student performance lists, and highlighted rosters of cohorts requiring academic support.

Strict Local Privacy and Security
Your student data belongs to you. Student Gradebook for Teachers operates with zero network requirements and zero data collection. All rosters, classes, marks, and formulas are securely stored locally inside an encrypted sandbox database on your mobile device.

Local Backup
Export class lists or share data across devices using local JSON backups. All backup and share processes are executed locally using standard secure device framework protocols.

==============================

Grade Corner is now part of the Student Data Privacy Consortium (SDPC) and is endorsed for use in the states of:

- Maine
- Massachusetts
- New Hampshire
- Rhode Island
- Vermont

==============================
Some Common Questions:

Q: Do I need an Aspen login to use the app?
A: Yes! If you don't know your credentials, ask your school administrator.

Q: What School Districts are supported?**
A: Currently, the following districts are fully supported:
- Public schools in Washington, DC
- Chicago Public Schools
- Boston Public Schools
- School districts in Massachusetts, Maine, New Hampshire, Rhode Island, and Vermont
- MySchoolSask and MyEducation BC
- MyOntarioEdu is supported, but you have to add the link under 'My School District is not listed'
- DoD Education Activity (DoDEA)
- And more!

Additional school districts can be added easily. However, due to the flexibility of the Aspen system, not all features may be available for custom Aspen systems.

Q: How do I know what my Aspen Id is?
A: Your Student Aspen Id is provided by your school district.
For Boston and DC - It's usually 6 to 7 digits such as: 12345567. Parents accounts are usually email addresses.
For CPS - Use the first part of your cps.edu email.
Contact your school administrator to obtain credentials.

Q: How often are grades updated?
A: Grades are updated by teachers periodically. When they do, students can see the updates right away using the App.

Q: Is this app officially supported by my School District?
A: It depends. Grade Corner was created independently by a frustrated parent who had two children attending public schools in Washington, DC. We are working on getting officially endorsed by school districts. Any endorsements by School Districts are listed above.

Q: Is my data secure?
A: As a parent, I understand being protective of grade information. Your grade information never leaves the app and is not stored in any way. See privacy policy for more details.

Each video only lasts a few minutes but you will sure learn a lot from them. You can also reach us through Instagram or Facebook. Links are under the menu inside the app.

This is a special call to landscape photographers, travel photographers, nature photographers and those who are interested in night photography, city photography, time-lapse, star-trails, milky way or astro-photography: look no more, this is the ultimate app for you - the Planit Pro. It only costs you a cup of Frappuccino but will save you tons of time and effort and a lot of gas money. Most importantly, it will make you enjoying landscape photography even more.

Ansel Adams dedicates the beginning of his first book "Taos Pueblo" to visualization. He introduced the idea of "previsualization", which involved the photographer imagining what he wanted his final print to look like before he even took the shot. Of course, there are many great photos which were taken impromptu. However, for landscape photographers, being able to previsualize the scene before going there will greatly reduce the chance of being caught unprepared and will greatly increase the chance of getting better shots.

Photographers use various tools to help them pre-visualizing the scene. Nowadays, many of those tools are phone apps. Planit Pro is an all-in-one solution that is designed to leverage the map and simulated viewfinder technologies to provide the necessary tools for photographers to pre-visualize the scene in combination with the ground subjects and the celestial objects such as the Sun, the Moon, Stars, Star-trails and Milky Way.

In the Planit Pro app, we packed it with features - from location scouting such as GPS coordinates, elevations, distance, elevation gain, clear view, focal length, depth of field (DoF), hyperfocal distance, panorama and aerial photography, to the Ephemeris features such as the sunrise, sunset, moonrise, moonset time and direction, twilight time, special hours of the day, sun/moon finder, major stars, constellations, nebulae azimuth and elevation angle, star trail planning, time-lapse calculation and simulation, sequence calculation and simulation, milky way searching, solar eclipse and lunar eclipse, exposure/ND filter calculator, light meter, rainbow position prediction, tide height and tide search etc. All the information are either represented on the map as an overlay or visually presented in simulated viewfinders (VR, AR, picture, or street view), just like you look through your camera's viewfinder. Whatever you want for your landscape photography, it is there in the Planit Pro.

Landscape photography is an adventure in the nature world. We understand sometimes there won't be any network connection when you are out exploring. Planit Pro was designed for have it in mind. If you preload the offline elevation files and the offline mbtiles maps, you can use the app fully offline without the need for network connections.

In the Planit Pro app, we packed it with features - from location scouting such as GPS coordinates, elevations, distance, elevation gain, clear view, focal length, depth of field (DoF), hyperfocal distance, panorama and aerial photography, to the Ephemeris features such as the sunrise, sunset, moonrise, moonset time and direction, twilight time, special hours of the day, sun/moon finder, major stars, constellations, nebulae azimuth and elevation angle, star trail planning, time-lapse calculation and simulation, sequence calculation and simulation, milky way searching, solar eclipse and lunar eclipse, exposure/ND filter calculator, light meter, rainbow position prediction, tide height and tide search etc. All the information are either represented on the map as an overlay or visually presented in simulated viewfinders (VR, AR, picture, or street view), just like you look through your camera's viewfinder. Whatever you want for your landscape photography, it is there in the Planit Pro.

Landscape photography is an adventure in the nature world. We understand sometimes there won't be any network connection when you are out exploring. Planit Pro was designed for have it in mind. If you preload the offline elevation files and the offline mbtiles maps, you can use the app fully offline without the need for network connections.

Use these insights to fine-tune your workouts, whether you're aiming to boost speed, enhance endurance, or perfect your technique.

Besides functioning as a sprint timer, the app also allows you to time your agility drills across various sports, such as American football, soccer, basketball, and more. Imagine polishing your technique under time pressure, building greater confidence in your abilities.
Coaches can add the participating athletes in the automatic series mode. Once set, there's no need to interact with the phones during training. Voice commands announce the next athlete, and all performances are recorded hands-free!

Photo Finish is designed for user-friendliness and effortless setup. Devices connect and synchronize via Bluetooth and subsequently share their timing data over the internet, ensuring limitless transmission range.

name: Exposure Calculator
description:
Capture the Light, Forget the Math.

Ever find yourself staring at a waterfall, holding a 10-stop ND filter, and trying to divide 1/125 by "darkness" in your head? We’ve all been there.

Whether you’re shooting long-exposure seascapes or pushing film in a vintage Leica, Exposure Calculator handles the arithmetic so you can focus on the art. It’s the Swiss Army knife for your camera bag—minus the bulky metal and the risk of cutting your thumb.

The Full Creative Toolkit

• The Master Calculator: Swap Aperture, Shutter Speed, or ISO on the fly. Set any two, and we’ll tell you the third. It’s like magic, but with physics.
• The ND Stack-O-Matic: Stack up to 3 ND filters (up to 30 stops!) without breaking a sweat. Perfect for turning choppy waves into mist or making tourists disappear from busy streets.
• Bulb & Long Exposure: From 4 seconds to 24 hours. We’ve even included a built-in timer and alarm, so you can go grab a coffee while your sensor drinks in the light.
• Reciprocity Failure: Film photographers, we see you. Account for the quirks of your favorite emulsion with the optional compensation wheel.

Pro Tools for Precision

• ND Calibration: Not all filters are created equal. Calibrate yours for pinpoint accuracy.
• Reverse Search: Know the look you want but not the filter you need? Work backward to find the perfect ND value.
• EV Readout: Get the Exposure Value of your scene at a glance.
• Night Vision Protection: Don't ruin your rods and cones. Use the custom color night mode to keep your eyes adjusted to the dark.

Why You’ll Love It

• Extreme Ranges: From f/1.0 to f/360 and ISO 0.4 to 3.2M.
• Total Customization: Define your own increments (1, 1/2, or 1/3 stops).
• Presets: Save your go-to setups for instant access.
• Pure & Clean: No ads, no tracking, and no personal data collection.

Stop guessing. Start calculating. Your sensor (and your brain) will thank you.

name: SolCalc - Solar Calculator
description:
SolCalc is a solar calculator that helps giving information about sun and moon.

This includes information about sunrise, sunset together with data of the blue hour, golden hour and twilight times (civil, nautical and astronomical). Furthermore you can calculate information about moonrise, moonset and moon phases (calculated data are approximations of +/- 1 day accuracy).
You also can calculate and visualize the shadow length that an object will create.

In this app you can view data for multiple locations. These can be defined manually or automatically by getting your GPS location. Additionally you have the opportunity to manually set timezones of the locations, which can be helpful if you are planning trips to locations with another timezone than the one, where you currently are in.

Core features at a glance
☀️ Calculation of sunrise, sunset and solar noon
🌗 Calculation of moonrise and moonset + moonphase
🌠 Calculation of civil blue hour
🌌 Calculation of twilight times (civil, nautical and astronomical)
🌅 Calculation of golden hour
💫 Visualization of the azimuth-data of sunrise, sunset, moonrise and moonset
💫 Visualization of the azimuth-data of sun and moon for specific time
💫 Calculation and visualization of the an object shadow (e.g. helpful for planning photovoltaics/pv alignment)
📊 Visualization of sun heigth over a day (zenith)
❖ definition of multiple locations, including current position (based on GPS)
❖ forecast

Pro features
❖ no limit in selecting a date for calculation (max. +-7 days in free version)
❖ full monthly forecast
❖ export of forecast-data to Excel-tables

Note: the calculated values are approximations to plan your photography trips. Additionally it depends on weather situation, how good or if the blue or golden hour is visible.

WHAT IS SHOT DESIGNER?

• CAMERA DIAGRAM - Shot Designer dramatically speeds up the Director's process of making camera diagrams. Create full-blown diagrams in minutes. The software does most of the work.
• ANIMATION - Animate your characters and cameras to move around your diagram in real-time. Previsualize the rhythm of a scene by seeing it play out.

Watch the feature-demo at http://www.hollywoodcamerawork.com/shot-designer-videos.html

CAMERA-BLOCKING ON STEROIDS

Shot Designer was developed by Per Holmes, the creator of the Hollywood Camera Work training.

Shot Designer is based on the realization that neither Camera Diagrams, Shot Lists, or Storyboards by themselves give you a satisfying understanding of camera-blocking -- you have to use them *together*.

Shot Designer is FAST. The app knows how Directing works and automatically does most of the work for you. Cameras rearrange themselves when you move characters. Animate characters and cameras with simple Walk To and Track To commands. Create sophisticated tracking shots with multiple marks. Shot Designer is fast enough that you can rearrange the diagram with actors waiting.

OTHER FEATURES

• Integrated Set Designer for building floor plans.
• Integrated Lighting Designer for DPs, with lighting symbols provided by Ari Golan of Atomic Imaging Studios Chicago.
• Import production drawings as backgrounds and block on top of them.
• Factory Templates of pre-made camera setups for any situation.
• Make your own templates as starting points for new scenes.
• Large and growing prop/furniture library. Email us requests, we'll build them.
• Scene Freeze: Experiment easily by taking snapshots you can return to (Pro).
• PDF/JPG/Excel export and emailing of Camera Diagrams and Shot Lists (Pro).
• Unlimited Folder Structure for organizing scenes (Pro).

The Free Version of Shot Designer is full-featured except for Save and Export. Your current scene is always saved, and you can be fully productive working on one scene at a time. The Pro Version (in-app upgrade) adds File Management, identical Mac/PC Desktop Version, PDF/JPG/Excel Export, Scene Freeze and more.

name: Stage Metronome with Setlist
description:
Tired of fumbling with tempo between songs? Stage Metronome lets you save every song's settings in a setlist — ready at the right BPM in one tap for every song in your set.

SETLIST FOR YOUR WHOLE SET

Build a setlist before the gig and store each song's tempo, time signature, beat pattern, and accent beats together. On stage, tap a song and everything loads instantly — no sliders, no reconfiguring under pressure. Export the setlist as a file and your bandmates can import the same settings on their own devices in seconds.

A DISPLAY YOU CAN READ FROM ACROSS THE ROOM

The beat number is large enough to read from behind a drum kit or across a stage. Full-screen mode shows only the beat number and beat lights — no controls, just a clear visual reference for the whole band. Three configurable beat light patterns and per-device audio-visual delay calibration ensure the click and the light land at the same moment on your specific device.

STAY IN CONTROL ON STAGE

Tap the SYNC button to reset the beat to 1 without stopping or changing tempo — useful when the count gets lost mid-song. Connect a Bluetooth page turner or headset to start, stop, navigate songs, and adjust volume without putting down your instrument. The metronome keeps running in the background when you switch apps or the screen turns off.

DIAL IN YOUR CLICK

Choose from 6 click sounds. Set the volume independently for the accent beat, the main beat, and the sub-beat so the click mix works in any monitor environment — from a quiet rehearsal room to a loud stage. Use tap tempo to set BPM by feel, or hit the half/double buttons to switch between full-time and half-time in an instant. Tempo range covers 10 to 500 BPM with 12 beat-pattern presets.

FOR PRACTICE AND REHEARSAL

All the same settings work for band rehearsal and solo practice. The in-app timer tracks session length. Notification controls let you start, stop, and manage the click from the lock screen without opening the app.

WHO IT'S FOR

Stage Metronome is built for live musicians and bands who need a reliable click track on stage — drummers keeping the kit locked to a setlist, guitarists and bassists who need the right tempo loaded without touching the phone mid-performance, and anyone who has lost their tempo at a gig because their metronome was too fiddly under pressure. Free, with no subscription required for setlist management.

ADVICE:
Try to memorize the track’s chords and study the pentatonic & other scales diagrams closely. Each key has less than 10 boxes! They are not really hard to remember! Finally, you should learn where each box starts for each key. In the end, you will be jamming along with any track effortlessly! More than 700 jam tracks for guitar are at your disposal!

CREATED BY GUITARISTS, FOR GUITARISTS
Practice makes perfect. Backing Tracks Guitar Jam offers an easy-to-use tool to help musicians of all levels master their art. It simulates a real-sounding band that can accompany you as you practice.
This app used by many music students, teachers and some of the world’s top music schools such as Berklee College of Music and Musicians Institute.

BUILD CONFIDENCE
Practicing your scales is the best way to get comfortable with the fretboard. Once your learn the at least 5 different shapes of the pentatonic scale in every key, you'll be able to play along and solo to nearly any song!

IT'S SO EASY TO USE
We created the simplest, fastest and most enjoyable way to practice guitar on a mobile device. Just tap a key and hit play!

FEATURES
☆ About 740 jam tracks in the constantly updating library. More than 400 of them are free!
☆ More than 30 music styles and genres to satisfy any taste: rock, hard rock, blues, jazz, metal, pop, country, soul, funk, acoustic, Indie rock punk rock, reggae, etc.
☆ Tempo change function.
☆ Key change function.
☆ Metronome.
☆ Recording yourself playing & singing along with the accompaniment.
☆ Scale library. Access to 2000+ guitar scales.
☆ Chord library. Access to 5000+ guitar chords.
☆ No more low-quality MIDI playback: app gives you access to more than 740 high-quality backing tracks to accompany you.
☆ A variety of playlist sorting and filtration options.

HOW IT WORKS:
1. Select a backing track (choose from the included 30 different accompaniment styles)
2. Adjust tempo and key.
3. Improve your skills by using Chords tab to view the chords used in the track and view the scale diagrams for solo and improvisation.
4. Jam on guitar and make practice fun! Focus on guitar techniques with collections of music from professional guitarists.

FOR RHYTHM AND LEAD PLAYERS
Every track has a listing of chords that are used in the track, along with scale charts - practice rhythm or lead with ease!

WHAT IS A PENTATONIC SCALE?
A pentatonic scale is one consisting of five notes, and that’s it! It is used widely in all genres and styles, and it is one of the most important scales for guitarists.
There are many forms & templates (boxes) for each key. The boxes remain unchanged, except starting positions are different.
Therefore, once you grasp one key, other ones will come much easier!

We strive for excellence, and we're always eager to improve your Guitar Jam experience!
Let us help you in person - contact developer at smakarovpro@gmail.com, and we'll do our best to meet your requests.

Whether you play piano, guitar, violin, drums, or sing — and whether you’re a beginner, a returning hobbyist, a student, or a serious musician — Practis turns everyday practice into real, visible progress.

Track every practice session
Start a session in seconds and keep your timer and metronome running while you play. Log what you worked on, build daily streaks, and see how your practice adds up over days, weeks, and months. It’s a practice journal, practice tracker, and progress report rolled into one.

Meet Ask Practis, your practice assistant
Not sure what to work on today? Just ask. Ask Practis looks at your real practice history and gives clear, personalized suggestions — what to review, what you’ve been avoiding, and where your time will make the biggest difference next.

Practice your sheet music
Bring in your sheet music and practice straight from your pieces. Practis shows which pages you actually spend time on with a visual practice heatmap, and points out the pages you’ve been neglecting — so nothing gets left behind before your lesson or performance.

Hear yourself improve
Record your playing and listen back over time to hear the difference between sessions.

Stay motivated and organized
• Practice timer with a distraction-free mode
• Metronome built for real sessions, not just quick taps
• Practice diary with streaks, insights and analytics
• Collections to organize your repertoire with progress, start dates and deadlines
• Program lists to plan ordered, timed practice routines
• Achievements and a Hall of Fame to celebrate your milestones
• Practice with friends to stay accountable and motivated
• Works offline — practice anywhere and sync when you’re back online

Build a practice habit that sticks
Practis is built to help you show up consistently, make every session count, and watch your playing improve — one session at a time. Perfect for students, teachers, and lifelong learners on any instrument.

Download Practis and make your practice time count.

name: Music Theory & Ear Training
description:
Some musicians hear a song once and just KNOW the chords. That's not a gift - it's a trained skill, and this app trains it from absolute zero.

Most apps teach you theory OR drill your ear. This one walks the whole path: understand it, hear it, then play it back - so knowledge turns into a musician's ear.

🌳 THE COMPLETE COURSE - 1,496 LESSONS
No experience needed. 12 levels take you from "what is a note?" to jazz harmony.
• Scales, keys, intervals, chords, progressions, rhythm, harmony
• EVERY page plays out loud - tap the piano keys, hear every example
• Read real notation, step by gentle step
• Diagrams you can touch: the circle of fifths, chord builders, rhythm grids

👂 EAR TRAINING THAT ACTUALLY STICKS
A guided 24-chapter journey across the night sky - not random drills.
• Start by feeling where notes want to resolve (the real foundation)
• Name intervals, chords, cadences and keys by ear
• Learn to PREDICT the next chord - the secret behind playing by ear
• Every answer explains WHY, so your ear and your brain grow together

🎤 THEN PLAY IT BACK FOR REAL
• Transcribe: a riff loops, you tap it back note by note
• Play It Back: hear a note, play it on your REAL guitar or piano - the mic checks your pitch
• Loop it, slow it, reveal it - work like musicians actually work

🧭 A COACH THAT KNOWS YOUR WEAK SPOTS
It tracks 21 skills separately and builds every session around what YOU find hard, with spaced repetition so nothing fades.

🔥 BUILT TO KEEP YOU GOING
Daily streaks, XP, levels, a weekly leaderboard - one streak across lessons AND ear training. Level up and unlock new instrument sounds.

🎸 PIANO AND GUITAR, EVERYWHERE
Real open-chord shapes, fretboard maps and keyboard diagrams side by side. Singers and producers welcome too - the ear training works for everyone.

💜 EVERYTHING FREE. NO ADS. NO PAYWALLS.
The full course and all 8 trainers, completely free. An optional account backs up progress and puts you on the leaderboard.

Five minutes a day. In a month you'll hear music differently. In a year you'll be the one who plays it after hearing it once.

name: Complete Rhythm Trainer
description:
The ultimate rhythm training app for musicians. Learn to read, recognize, tap and write rhythms from simplest to most advanced. Rhythm is one of the most important aspects of music and one that every musician should become proficient with. Designed like a video game and with strong pedagogical concepts in mind, this app will make you master rhythm while rendering the learning process enjoyable.


Features

• 252 progressive drills arranged over 4 levels / 30 chapters
• Extensive content: from simple time signatures to compound and asymmetric time signatures, from half notes and quarter notes to thirty-second notes, triplets, swing eighths, double dotted notes, quintuplets, ...
• 5 drill types: rhythm imitation drills, rhythm reading drills, rhythm dictations, two-voice reading drills and two-voice dictations
• Play a selection of 11 drills in arcade mode
• Play and practice polyrhythms in a dedicated polyrhythm section
• Most of the drills are randomly generated, enabling you to practice the studied rhythms as many times as needed
• 23 instrument sound banks with actual recorded sounds: piano, guitar, pizzicato violin, conga, bongo, djembe, darabuka, woodblock, ...
• Designed like a video game: earn 3 stars in each drill of a chapter to complete it. Or will you be able to obtain perfect 5-star scores?
• Don't want to follow the preestablished path of progression? Create and save your own custom drills and rehearse them at your own convenience
• Create full custom training programs and invite friends or students to join them. If for example you're a teacher you can create custom programs for your students, add drills every week and view their scores on private leaderboards
• Never lose any progress: cloud sync across your various devices
• Google Play Games: 25 achievements to unlock
• Google Play Games: leaderboards to compare arcade mode scores with other players worldwide
• Nice and clean material design user interface with 2 display themes: light and dark
• 4 sheet music display styles: modern, classic, handwritten and jazz
• Designed by a musician and music teacher with a Royal Conservatory master's degree


Full Version

• Download the app and try out the first two chapters for free
• One-time in-app purchase of $5.99 to unlock the full version on all your Android devices


Having a problem? Got a suggestion? You can reach us at hello@completerhythmtrainer.com

Being a FTM (first-time mom), or new mom, in general, is very tiring and challenging! You got through pregnancy, you’ve probably just made it home from the hospital, are totally exhausted, and a little overwhelmed by your new responsibilities. The first few months of your baby’s life mostly revolves around a schedule of eating, sleeping, diaper changes and occasional little doctor’s visits.

It’s not always easy to remember the last time you fed your baby or changed their nappy. It’s very helpful to monitor everything and get a quick glance to remind you the last time you did it, or the next time you have to. It will definitely give you a peace of mind and make your day that much easier to have a log to check whenever needed.

It’s extremely important to track when you had your last feeding session, but also track the weight and how long they were eating to make sure they’re eating properly and gaining weight at a normal rate.

Also, keeping track of diapers is very imperative to keeping your baby healthy. All moms definitely need an easy way to check how often they’re changing diapers. Not to mention, you should definitely track if everything looks normal during diaper changes.

For some parents, it’s very important to track every ounce of food and it’s imperative they have a baby feeding tracker. Some babies, unfortunately, have minor illnesses after coming home from the hospital. Keeping track of all this information will help your baby on the road to recovery and healthy growth much more easily.

As a new mom, don’t forget to take care of yourself as well. The first few weeks will be tiring! There will definitely be times you fall asleep on the couch suddenly, and everyone needs some help or handy reminders. Alarms and graphs are a great way to have an at-a-glance look at what you need to do without stressing over “what if I forget?”.

Just click the appropriate button to begin feeding, or other activities. Your baby care history will be reliably stored. All this information may be useful when you visit the pediatrician, as well as for the further development of your child.

Feed baby easily and quickly. This breastfeeding app helps you track everything and enjoy motherhood.

👋 Say hi to Napper, the award-winning, all-in-one, baby sleep and parenting app that will help you get better sleep, connect with your children and get the most out of parenthood!



Have you ever heard about awake windows and sleep pressure? If not, those are the two pillar stones of baby sleep. Napper helps you find your child's natural rhythm and creates a daily schedule based on that rhythm so that you'll always put your baby down at the perfect time.

Tailor-made baby sleep schedule


With Napper’s tailor-made baby sleep schedule, you’ll never have to worry about putting your baby down at the right time. Your baby’s daily nap chart automagically adjusts according to your child’s natural sleep rhythm, making naptime and bedtime a breeze!

Baby sleep sounds (white noise & lullabies)


With the help of a composer, Napper has constructed a soundscape to help your baby sleep better with our custom made baby sleep sounds and white noises. More sounds are added on a regular basis, but current sounds include a soothing rain, sounds from the forest, and sounds from the womb.

Science-based baby sleep & attachment parenting course


Napper’s baby sleep and attachment parenting course helps you improve your sleeping situation in 14 days or less! The course is written in collaboration with sleep experts and based on the latest research on sleep and parenting.

Baby tracker for sleep, breastfeeding, solids & more


Napper’s baby tracker lets you track everything from breastfeeding sessions to medication and bottle feedings. You can use the baby tracker to track in real-time or in retrospect.

Comprehensive trends & statistics


Get an extensive overview of your child’s patterns and weekly routine with Napper’s trends and statistics. The things you track will show up in our beautiful and easy-to-read graphs, and you’ll easily be able to spot inconsistencies, irregularities, and correlations.

A positive parenting solution


One of the single most influential factors in long-term child happiness is whether or not their parents enjoy being parents. Happy parents raise happy children - not the other way around.

So when we designed Napper, it was with the intention of becoming the world’s first parenting app that turned the spotlight on you, the parent. In fact we’re on a mission to help each parent go to bed feeling like The Best Mom or Dad in the World, every day!

name: Baby Sleep Tracker - Midmoon
description:
Midmoon: Baby Sleep & Feeding is an app that helps moms create a daily schedule of their baby's sleep, nutrition, and activity. It offers a personal newborn breastfeeding tracker, an infant food diary, and a baby sleep timer, allowing you to track detailed statistics of your child's daily routine and receive timely notifications.

The app is beneficial for moms of newborn babies, moms of children under one-year-old, moms of children older than one year, as well as all parents, grandparents, nannies, and other caregivers responsible for the child.

In the application, you can find a baby sleep tracker, breastfeeding tracker, feeding tracker, baby activity log, timers and notifications, dark and light themes, and a user-friendly interface without unnecessary functions.

To use the app, you need to note all of your child's activities, including sleeping and feeding, complementary feeding by months, games, active and quiet waking, walks, etc. The app then calculates an individual, comfortable schedule just for your child, based on recommended norms and their personal needs.

The app also tells you when and why your baby might start to be cranky and when to start the bedtime routine, even if there are no visible signs of fatigue.

The Midmoon: Baby Sleep & Feeding app is convenient because it allows you to plan the day and anticipate your baby's desires before they get tired or start to cry.

Features of the app include a sleep tracker, child feeding (breastfeeding or artificial feeding), complementary foods by month (vegetables, fruit, cereals, meat, etc.), all kinds of activities (massage, walking, playing, bathing, etc.), and a baby development journal.

You can try the app for free for 7 days, and then choose the subscription period that is most comfortable for you. The subscription renews automatically at the end of each period (week, month, half-year, year, or otherwise, depending on your chosen option). Canceling your subscription means auto-renewal will be turned off, but you will still have access to all app features for the remainder of your current period. Note that uninstalling the app does not cancel your subscriptions.

Midmoon: Baby Sleep & Feeding is a simple and helpful app for you and your baby, with nothing unnecessary.

name: My Baby Tracker: Feeding Sleep
description:
Everything for baby care in one app: feeding, sleep, diapers, growth and development tracker.

Baby daybook: breastfeeding and bottle feeding, sleep schedule, diaper log, weight and height

The first months with your baby are a special time when every day matters for your infant's development. Parents want to understand how their baby eats, how much sleep they get, whether diapers are changed regularly, and if growth is on track. Our baby daybook helps make parenting simple, organized, and calm - from the first days of breastfeeding to establishing feeding and sleep routines.

"My Baby Tracker" is created for parents who want to easily track their baby's feeding, monitor sleep patterns, log diaper changes, and follow their infant's development.

What's inside the app:

Main screen with latest baby data
Convenient dashboard shows all important information about your baby in one place: when was the last breastfeeding or bottle feeding, how much time has passed since last sleep, when the diaper was changed, current infant weight and height. All information at your fingertips - you instantly see your baby's status.

Feeding tracker
Record every feeding: breastfeeding, bottle feeding, or formula. Mark start time and duration, which breast, amount of formula. Feeding timer helps you remember when baby ate last. Statistics show nursing frequency and help establish a feeding routine.

Sleep diary
Log every baby sleep: when fell asleep, how long slept, sleep quality. Sleep tracker shows total daily sleep time and helps build a routine. You'll see if your infant gets enough rest and how sleep patterns change over time.

Diaper tracking
Mark diaper changes and their contents. This is important for monitoring baby health: the number of wet and dirty diapers shows whether the infant is getting enough nutrition and how digestion is working.

Growth and weight
Record measurements of height, weight, head circumference. Growth charts show dynamics and help track how your baby is growing. Compare indicators with norms and share data with your pediatrician.

Growth and weight standards
Built-in standards help understand if baby weight and height correspond to age norms. You see how your infant develops compared to standard indicators for breastfed or formula-fed babies.

Sleep norms by age
Compare your baby's sleep patterns with recommended norms for their age. The app shows how much an infant should sleep at different months and helps understand if your baby is getting enough rest.

Development calendar
Track important milestones in baby development: when started holding head, rolling over, sitting, crawling. Development calendar suggests what skills appear at each age and helps not miss important moments.

Teething order
Mark the appearance of baby's first teeth and track teething order. Teething calendar shows typical sequence and timing of infant tooth appearance, helps prepare for this period.

Statistics and charts
All records about feeding, sleep, diapers are collected into visual charts. You see baby's daily routine, nursing frequency, total sleep time and can notice changes in development. This helps better understand infant needs.

Notes and reminders
Add notes about baby's wellbeing, mood, feeding or sleep specifics. Set reminders for next feeding or sleep time so you don't miss important moments.

"My Baby Tracker" - your reliable parenting assistant. Everything you need to track feeding, sleep, diapers, and development - in one place.

name: Breastfeeding Newborn tracker
description:
The simplest program to track breastfeeding, pumping, bottle feeding, solid food consumption, diapers, sleep schedule, height and weight, and more.

With the click of a button your feedings and baby care history will be stored in the app. You will have an easy-to-maintain history of your baby’s growth.

In the application, you can share baby's data with your partner, relatives, or nanny. Syncing data between multiple devices is available for free.

The birth of a baby is a miracle that fills your heart with joy! A mother’s life changes dramatically with the birth of her baby. It is so important for a mother and her newborn baby to establish a comfortable breastfeeding relationship. Moms need to keep track of which breast to offer her baby, how long the baby suckles at each breast, the number of times the baby breastfeeds each day, how many wet diapers and bowel movements the baby has, how long and frequently the baby sleeps, as well as the baby’s weight and growth. All of this information is important for the self-assessment of breastfeeding and for assessing the growth of the child. Having this information easily accessible will be extremely useful when visiting with your pediatrician or lactation consultant.

It is important to record all of this data. Do not rely on your memory, because even the most organized mothers are often lost in the sea of information about their newborn.

Use the features of the Breastfeeding application.

Breastfeeding and pumping:
- record the time and quantity of feedings and / or pumpings;
- note which breast was fed or pumped last to ensure starting new feeding/pumping on the opposite breast;
- record the duration of feeding / pumping;
- pause feeding / pumping, if necessary;
- brief feedings / pumpings, or those that occur within a short period of time, are grouped into one feeding / pumping event
- quickly add feeding / pumping session that was similar to the most recent but update with current time
- use the maximum duration of feeding setting and the application will stop recording the feeding / pumping at the set time if you are unable to press stop

Liquids:
- consider all of your child’s fluid intake (water, expressed breast milk, formula, juice, etc.);
-track your child’s reactions to new fluids and leave comments for yourself and other caregivers;
- set the default fluid volume (can be edited as needed);

Feeding (solid food):
- add solid foods as your child begins eating them (cereal, vegetables, fruits, meat, fish);
- track your child’s reactions to these new foods and leave comments for yourself and other caregivers
- set the default fluid volume (can be edited as needed);

Sleep:
- record the time and duration of your baby’s sleep each day so you can better plan your day;
- compare your baby’s sleep habits with recommended sleep guidelines


Diapers:
- track the number of your baby’s wet and / or dirty diapers. This information is crucial for noticing signs of dehydration, constipation, and diarrhea and alerting the child’s pediatrician if necessary.

Measurements:
- track height and weight to evaluate your baby’s development;

Other features:
- edit or delete events as needed;
- set reminders for various events;
- use the application in your native language (more than 40 languages available);
- select your preferred units of measurement (ounces or milliliters);
- browse graphs;
- view statistics;
- enter data for several children and twins;
- backup all of your data;
and more!

PRO-version
- disable advertising;
- install widgets for quick viewing and launch;
- auto backup every 24 hours;
- export to Excel


We are constantly working to improve the application. Write to us with questions and suggestions.

Plop helps you understand your digestive health through intelligent pattern recognition and personalized insights. By combining easy daily logging with advanced health analysis, Plop empowers you to identify what affects your gut and make informed decisions about your wellness.

Discover Your Unique Patterns
Pattern recognition is the core of the Plop experience. The app analyzes your data to reveal insights that are difficult to see on your own:
* Personal Baseline:
Plop establishes your individual normal from your logging history. The app learns what is typical for your body and alerts you to meaningful deviations.
* Visual Trend Analysis:
Spot rhythms in your health with over 10 interactive charts. These visuals make it easy to see if your bowel movements shift with your lifestyle habits or follow a weekly pattern.
* ML-Driven Alerts:
Receive automatic notifications when ML-driven analytics detect significant changes in your frequency or consistency.
* Factor Correlations:
See how specific triggers like stress, diet, medications or sleep actually impact your digestion through visual correlation analysis.


Effortless, Quick-Tap Logging
Consistency is the most important part of health tracking, so Plop makes it fast and friction-free:
* Rapid Entry:
Log a new entry in seconds by selecting the date, time, and Bristol Scale shape classification, alongside basic symptoms and stool conditions.
* Fully Customizable:
Create unique factors based on your doctor’s advice or specific health conditions to monitor what matters most to your personal journey.
* Optional Depth:
Add photos, notes, or create more factor tags when you want to dive deeper into your documentation.
* Flexible History:
Review your history in a calendar or list view and easily edit past entries if you make a mistake.


Doctor-Ready Reports
Plop bridges the gap between personal tracking and medical care by generating reports that healthcare providers understand:
* Monthly Report:
The app synthesizes your data into reports that summarize your regularity and trends.
* Shareable Data:
Export your insights as professional PDF or CSV files to share with your gastroenterologist during your next appointment.


Your Privacy, Your Control
Your health information is personal and sensitive, which is why Plop uses a local-first architecture:
* On-Device Storage:
Your data lives on your device by default and the app works fully offline.
* Optional Cloud Sync:
You decide whether to enable cloud backup or sync across multiple devices.
* No Data Selling:
Your health insights remain yours alone, giving you complete control over your sensitive information.


Who is Plop For?
Plop is designed for anyone looking to see their gut health more clearly, including:
* Individuals managing chronic conditions like IBS, Crohn’s, or Ulcerative Colitis.
* People identifying food sensitivities or tracking an elimination diet.
* Health-conscious users who want to understand how lifestyle factors like stress and exercise affect their body.

Download Plop today to start exploring your health patterns. The core experience is free for everyone, with premium options available for those who want deeper correlation analysis and advanced pattern detection.


Medical Disclaimer
Plop is a personal tracking and wellness tool, not a medical device. It is not intended to diagnose, treat, or prevent any disease. ML-driven insights and alerts are for informational purposes to support—not replace—professional medical advice. Always consult your doctor or gastroenterologist regarding your digestive health. Use is at your own risk.

name: Elderly Care: health + protect
description:
This senior app improves a loved ones physical and mental health and well-being by helping them:
* to be more socially connected and more active (raises happiness and well-being)
* to maintain independence (help family and caregivers to remotely monitor and support them)
* to manage health and self-care (automatic popup medicine reminders…)
* to feel safe and protected (panic button, GPS tracking, motion sensor…)

This health app makes it easier for a family and caregivers to care for and get closer to their senior loved ones.

This senior care app allows people to create a closed private care group: people in the group are securely connected and are able to share and see whats happening.

How it can help you:

[1] Senior health app
This senior health app helps a person establish and maintain daily mental and physical health routines. Features sensors, daily recurring tasks and reminders to help a person improve their ability to self-care.

[2] Senior safety app & Panic button
This senior safety app uses phone/tablet sensors and home IoT sensors to monitor and detect problems. It alerts family and caregivers in the care-group. Great for senior safety. A Panic button (SOS app) works 24/7 indoors and outdoors. The GPS tracker with geo-fencing can tell you when a loved one leaves home and when they arrive back.

[3] Daily senior living
This senior citizen app allows a senior to be socially engaged, contribute to family or community, continue with activities that give life meaning, and to maintain choice and control. Automatic sensor notifications help a person to feel connected and involved with their family.

[4] Senior care app
A remote family member can receive an automatic notification telling them what time their loved one woke up (which is nice and reassuring), and more notifications throughout the day: what time they took their medicine; if they went outside for a walk, and what time a caregiver went to visit them, etc.. The app has special large icons that make it easier for a person to express the care needs and feelings.

[5] Dementia and Alzheimer’s app
If a loved one suffers from a decline in memory or confusion, perhaps Alzheimer’s disease, dementia or Parkinson’s disease, then this senior app can support daily living. You can setup tasks remotely, add notes and add photos, it will then pop-up as a notification on your loved ones phone. Great for independent living.

[6] Elderly phone app
This elderly phone app has background sensors that run 24/7 and lets family and caregivers see how much the phone/tablet device is being used and whether the battery is being kept charged,…

[7] Elderly launcher app
This elderly launcher app has large buttons for making phone calls, opening favorite websites, and clicking favorite places for Sat-Nav. So no fiddly keyboard typing. A great feature of this senior launcher app is that it can be setup remotely by family and caregivers.

[8] Caregivers app
This caregivers app helps organize care visits and enables remote caregivers to monitor and support the health & well-being of seniors with a wide range of care needs and frailty: motion sensors can monitor people with mobility and fall safety concerns; automatic care-plan popup reminders help people maintain their health and independence,…

PRIVACY
This senior citizen app works by consent - each person can chose what features to switch on and share.

SUMMARY - This senior app is designed to promote senior safety, senior health, and senior living. The app features built-in phone sensors, external home IoT sensors (due October 2021), GPS tracking and automatic geo-fence location alerts, and advanced daily recurring tasks and reminders to protect and monitor the health of an elderly person. It’s great for someone who is active and independent, and also for those with health issues, such as frailty, Alzheimer’s or Dementia, and need additional support and care. And its a senior launcher app with large buttons for phone calls and websites.

Caregiver is a caregiving app and senior care organizer for adult children and siblings: each loved one gets one care hub with a shared calendar, medication tracker, tasks, care logs, vitals, document vault, and live updates, so everyone in the care circle stays aligned without endless texts.

Whether you’re caring for an aging parent at home, in assisted living, or from a distance, Caregiver helps families coordinate senior care in one shared place.

Care is shared, visible, and organized so nothing gets missed. Families stay aligned, reduce stress, and spend less time tracking updates—and more time supporting the people they love.

SHARED MEDICATION TRACKER
Log doses, set reminders, and reduce “Did Dad take his meds?” anxiety. Everyone in the care circle sees what matters, without turning care into a spreadsheet.

SHARED CAREGIVER CALENDAR & APPOINTMENTS
Put appointments in one shared calendar in the care hub so siblings, helpers, and primary caregivers stay aligned. Great when you’re coordinating doctor visits, therapies, and visits across cities.

SHARED TASKS, CARE CHECKLISTS & DUE DATES
Turn vague worries into a shared task list: errands, follow-up items, home safety tasks, and care plan steps with notes and due dates everyone in the circle can act on together.

SHARED CARE LOGS, VITALS & HEALTH TREND CHARTS
Log blood pressure, blood sugar, temperature, mood, and daily notes in one shared care hub. Health trend charts help your family spot patterns over time and bring clearer context to appointments.

SHARED DOCUMENT VAULT FOR ELDERLY PARENT RECORDS
Keep insurance cards, IDs, medication lists, and visit notes in one secure place in the hub, so the right file is there in stressful moments.

SHARED FAMILY UPDATES WITHOUT THE UPDATE TEXTS
See recent activity across medications, tasks, appointments, care logs, and documents. Fewer repeated questions; clearer accountability for everyone in the care circle helping Mom or Dad.

FREE TO START
Essentials for care coordination are available without blocking the basics behind a paywall. When you need more, subscriptions unlock extra capacity like a larger care circle, more loved one profiles, expanded document storage, health trend charts, and longer care log history.

PRIVACY & TRUST
No ads in the app — we’re supported by optional Premium subscriptions, not banner ads. Your family’s information matters; review our Privacy Policy in the app or on our website.

Caregiver supports care coordination; it does not replace professional medical advice. Always follow your health professional’s guidance.

name: LD-Log - GPS Tracker & Logbook
description:
✸ Multifunctional track logger for a wide range of uses
✸ Optimized for battery-efficient long-term tracking
✸ In-app travel diary / nautical logbook
✸ Maps and tools for outdoor navigation

➤ LD-Log tracks your travel routes using the device's GPS receiver. Waypoints are taken either manually or automatically with a user-definable interval set in minutes. As such, the app is designed to consume very little battery power. LD-Log also offers a tracking mode, allowing you to record your movements by the second.
➤ An editable waypoint-list for each route of your trip lets you create a detailed diary of your complete journey. LD-Log will allow you to enter text or shoot photos in-app as well as import them at a later time. As a sailor, use the sail mode which lets you keep a complete nautical ship's log in an intuitive manner. Many different options are available for convenient storage of trips, routes and journals.
➤ The map view features a selection of different online map sources. Previously viewed map tiles will remain available while offline. You may also include custom offline maps. Create destination points and navigate with the help of the integrated bearing compass and the numerous map tools, whether in the open country or at sea.
➤ LD-Log can be used to document a wide range of travel situations including: hikes, bicycle tours, offshore sailing cruises, city walks, voyages, road trips, ship and boat tours, photo geotagging, collecting geo locations (POI), cartography (e.g. in forestry), etc. - for professional or recreational use.

This is the full version of LD-Log.
If you would like to try it first, search for the free version LD-Log Lite.

FEATURES
✹ Minimal power usage
✹ Works offline (no data connection needed)
✹ Runs in standby mode, in background and in parallel to other GPS-apps
✹ Switchable tracking mode allows recording by the second
✹ Editable waypoints (diary / logbook function)
✹ Quick menu for immediately adding waypoints with text entries or photos (no waiting for GPS necessary)
✹ Multiple images for each waypoint possible (direct capture or image import)
✹ Map view with editable waypoints and functions for outdoor navigation
✹ Selection of different online map sources like OpenStreetMaps, OpenSeaMaps, OpenTopoMaps, USGS, NOAA Nautical Charts and many more
✹ Map cache for offline usage, support for custom offline maps
✹ Manual destination entry, direct map-based destination marking, import of destinations from KML files
✹ Integrated bearing compass with direction display and distance to destination point a.o.
✹ Unlimited number of routes (i.e. trip-days) per trip
✹ Sail mode: log separate distances for sail / engine, standardized nautical logbook entries for trip, routes and waypoints
✹ Import trips and routes from GPX files
✹ Export trips, routes and waypoints as GPX / KML or KMZ files with embedded images and send
✹ Create travel reports (travel diary / notebook) as CSV tables, text or HTML files; these can include images, be printed (e.g. as PDF) and sent
✹ Save and load trips, with a detailed overview of all saved trips
✹ Wide selection of units available for recording date, distance and position (supports UTM WGS84/ETRS89)
✹ Many preset options for logging and GPS settings, all fully customizable
✹ Detailed manual and in-app help
✹ Requires only essential permission requests (location, storage, network, standby)
✹ Maximum privacy via local data storage

More info, manual and help under http://ld-log.com

name: WanWanWalk - Dog Walk Planner
description:
Every walk safer, every memory kept. WanWanWalk is built for dog owners in Japan: personalized walks for your dog's breed, age, and weight; paw safety alerts against scorching summer pavement; daily care logs your family shares; a portable electronic vet record; and a digital meishi book of every dog you meet. 100+ breeds covered — Shiba, Toy Poodle, Chihuahua, Dachshund, and Japan's other favorites.

GETTING STARTED
Three steps: pick your dog's breed, enter age and weight, you're in. No sign-in needed for core features. Family Sharing and Paw Pals exchange connect with your Google account in one tap.

WALK PLANNING
Your dog's breed, age, weight, and energy level drive personalized recommendations: walks per day, minutes each, distance. A high-energy breed gets longer walks; a calmer one gets shorter; a senior gets gentler sessions; a puppy gets a careful start. Pick a destination on the map for a suggested route. Adjust on the fly.

WEATHER & PAW SAFETY
Summer pavement in Japan can hit 60°C (140°F)+ — hot enough to burn unprotected paw pads. WanWanWalk reads temperature, humidity, ground temp, and UV index in real time, then surfaces a Safe / Caution / Danger gauge. In winter, the same gauge warns about freezing surfaces. Today's best walk windows (morning, evening) come from the day's weather curve. Push notifications fire before conditions worsen.

VET RECORDS & CARE EVENTS
Show any new vet your dog's full medical history on your phone, instantly. Vaccinations, rabies certificates, visit notes, prescriptions — all in one place. Attach photos, PDFs, X-rays. One tap exports a shareable PDF you can email. Each vaccination is date-stamped so you know when boosters are due.

Daily care is one tap from Home — fed, treat, meds, toilet, groomed. The chip stamps the time, so "when did I last feed her?" is always answered. In a shared household, every member sees who did what and when.

FAMILY SHARING
"Has anyone fed her yet?" "Who's walking her tonight?" "Did she take her meds?" When the family looks after one dog, share everything. Invite members by QR or link. Walks, food, meds, vet visits, play — every action shows on the Home activity feed in real time. Profiles, walk history, photos, and vet records sync across the household.

PAW PALS — YOUR DOG'S MEISHI BOOK
When your dog meets a new pup, exchange Dog Cards by QR in seconds. Both owners tap "scan" and each card — name, breed, photo — lands in your meishi book. Recurring friends are detected automatically from time, place, and breed. Tap a card to read about that breed in the built-in encyclopedia.

RAINBOW BRIDGE (NEW)
Honor the dogs who've crossed. A dedicated memorial page — rainbow-halo photo, story, memories, gallery, anniversaries, and a shareable card.

WALK TRACKING & HEALTH
GPS records every walk's route, distance, duration, and pace. The post-walk summary shows results at a glance, with space for keepsake photos. Auto-syncs to Health Connect so your steps and your dog's walks share one timeline. Past walks live in a calendar view; monthly totals tally automatically; favorite routes save (Plus).

PRIVACY FIRST
Your data and your dog's are yours. Walk routes, photos, and dog profiles are stored securely in your account. No ad tracking, and your location data is never used for advertising or sold to anyone. Family Sharing and Paw Pals show other users only your nickname — your name and email stay private.

WANWANWALK PLUS
For owners who want more depth. Manage multiple dogs, save favorite routes, view your full walk history, get a 7-day weather forecast, join Paw Pal challenges, collect season-limited Dog Card designs, unlock the full breed database, and get a year-in-review report.
¥300/month or ¥2,800/year (about 2 months free). 7-day free trial. Cancel anytime.

description:
Vetster connects you with trusted veterinarians available 24/7 to provide online care for your pet from the comfort of your own home. Get ongoing care for $10/month or book a single appointment.

Where available, our virtual veterinarians can also provide prescriptions for medication. Vetster is here to help from initial concern to diagnosis to prescription delivery.

Don’t wait! Get the care for your pet when you need it.

Vetster’s online veterinary doctors can help with:

- Itchy skin, excessive scratching, or fleas
- Irritated ears: shaking head, scratching, discharge, or odor
- Vomiting, diarrhea, or straining to poop
- Urinary problems: urinating more than normal, straining to urinate, or bloody urine.
- Eye problems
- Breathing issues: coughing, sneezing, or nasal congestion
- Limping, pain, or injury
- Ingestion of something potentially harmful.

Is your Dutch Terrier experiencing fatigue? Does your pet choke on their chewy toy?

Ask a vet your questions and receive peace of mind as well as pet health treatment. Whether you need an emergency vet, pet drugs or medicine from a pharmacy or veterinarian care for an animal species that's not common, the Vetster app can provide professional telehealth help right away.

When your vet clinic is closed, but you need answers—and quickly—Vetster has got you covered 24/7. Take out the stress and worry by getting the answers you need to take care of your pet from the comfort of your own home.

Using Vetster is simple and convenient:

- Download the Vetster App
- Create your free Vetster account
- Find a veterinarian based on your pet’s needs
- Choose your preferred time/date for an appointment
- Your Vetster Vet will confirm your appointment
- Change of plans? No worries! Reschedule for a credit or refund

What to expect during your appointment?

After booking your appointment, you’ll be connected to a licensed veterinarian or veterinary technician via video chat.

Similar to an in-person appointment, the licensed veterinarian or technician will ask you questions about your pet and their health history. They may also want to see your pet up-close to better examine them and gather more information about a tentative diagnosis.

The vet will let you know what the next steps are (such as booking an in-person appointment, sending you a prescription, how to treat at home, etc.)

That’s it!

Why choose Vetster?

Thousands of pet owners trust Vetster and our five-star rated virtual vets. Pets love it too because fewer trips to the vet mean less stress for them! Best of all, creating an account is 100% free!

name: Pet Pill Reminder & Tracker
description:
Pet Pill Reminder helps you keep every pet's medication routine organized, accurate, and easy to review.

It is built for pet owners who need more than a basic alarm. Track medications for dogs, cats, rabbits, birds, reptiles, and other pets, then log what was given, skipped, early, or late.

FEATURES:

- Medication reminders - Set daily, every-other-day, weekly, or custom schedules.
- Multi-pet support - Keep each pet's medications and records separate.
- Dose tracking - Record tablets, half tablets, syringes, drops, liquids, capsules, and more.
- Inventory tracking - Enter current supply and low-supply thresholds, then let logged doses update stock automatically.
- Low inventory alerts - See when a medication is running low before you miss a refill.
- Accurate dose history - Review scheduled time, given time, skipped doses, and late doses.
- Editable given times - Correct a logged time from the History screen.
- Early logging support - Log a dose up to one hour before the scheduled time.
- CSV and PDF export - Share medication records with your veterinarian or keep a backup.
- Follow-up reminders - Get an extra reminder if a scheduled dose has not been logged.
- Dark mode - A calmer view for evening care routines.

PET CARE IS MESSY:

Real medication routines are not always exact. A dose may be given a little early. A morning medication may be added after starting the schedule in the evening. A bottle may run low sooner than expected. Pet Pill Reminder is designed around those real-world moments.

PREMIUM:

Pet Pill Reminder offers an optional one-time Premium unlock for ad removal, dark mode, export, and follow-up reminders. No subscription is required.

PRIVACY:

Your pet profiles and medication records are stored locally on your device. No account is required.

Made by MyQuietSpot Inc.
