name: DoseBuddy: Medication Reminder
description:
DoseBuddy is a medication reminder app that helps you stay consistent with every dose reminder and keep your medication schedule on track. Whether you manage daily prescriptions, vitamins, or short-term treatments, DoseBuddy reduces missed doses with reliable alerts, clear logging, and fast setup.

A Smarter Medication Schedule:
Create a personalized medication schedule in minutes with exact times, frequencies, and instructions for each medicine. DoseBuddy gives you dependable reminders, adaptive snooze options, and persistent notifications for important doses.

When routines change, you can quickly update your plan so your medication schedule always stays accurate.

- Custom recurring reminders for prescriptions, supplements, and as-needed meds
- Flexible alert timing and snooze controls
- Strong prescription reminder support for long-term adherence

Pill Tracker:
DoseBuddy includes a dedicated pill tracker for daily adherence. Mark doses as taken, skipped, or delayed in one tap, then review a clean history anytime.
The pill tracker helps you spot patterns early, improve consistency, and stay prepared for doctor visits.

- Pill tracker history with timestamps
- Pill tracker views for missed and completed doses
- Better refill and adherence visibility

Medication Tracker & Log:
Use DoseBuddy as a full medication tracker with detailed logs for each dose. Record amount, notes, symptoms, and vitals in one place to keep your care data organized.

The medication tracker timeline helps you connect how you feel with what you took, making follow-ups more productive.

- Complete medication tracker records for daily use
- Calendar-based medication log and history reports
- Shareable summaries for care teams and appointments

Why Choose DoseBuddy?
- Smart alerts built for real-world routines
- Simple organization for any medication plan
- Safety-focused tools, including interaction checks
- Private by default, with optional PIN or biometrics
- QR transfer to move data to a new device seamlessly

Private by Default
No account is required. Your health data stays on your device, not on a remote server. For extra protection, lock the app with biometrics or a PIN.

DoseBuddy Pro: Take Control
- Wear OS Tile: See your next dose at a glance and take quick actions from your watch
- Wear OS Complication: Show upcoming medication info directly on compatible watch faces
- Barcode Scanning: Add medications faster with label scans
- Family Circle: Caregiver alerts with real-time notifications
- Secure Backups: Export and restore via Google Drive or iCloud
- PDF Reports: Detailed medication history for your physician
- Savings: Built-in prescription coupon search

FAQ:
How does DoseBuddy work as a medication reminder?
DoseBuddy sends dependable alerts, recurring schedules, and persistent notifications so you can stay on time with every dose.

Can I use DoseBuddy as a pill tracker?
Yes. The app includes a pill tracker for logging taken, skipped, and delayed doses with full history.

How does the dose reminder feature help me avoid missed doses?
Each dose reminder can be customized with timing and snooze settings, including persistent alerts for critical medications.

Can I set a medication schedule for multiple medications?
Yes. You can manage complex multi-medication routines with different times, frequencies, and instructions.

Is DoseBuddy a prescription reminder app too?
Yes. DoseBuddy supports recurring prescription reminder workflows for both short-term and ongoing treatments.

Important: DoseBuddy is not a medical device and does not diagnose, treat, or prevent any condition. It does not provide medical advice. Always follow guidance from your healthcare professional.

name: The Log: Potty Training + EC
description:
Stop over-offering and second-guessing yourself…and become a potty pro (or at least better than you were last week!) with this app.

Whether you are potty training your toddler or doing elimination communication (EC or infant potty training) with your 0-18 month baby, you need this app!

Observation time is key for knowing your little one’s natural timing intervals (how often s/he goes potty) and keeping track of any baby signals (or “peepee dances”) you see.

But forget that printable log you got from my website! You can now digitally track how often your baby pees or poops during observation time, or potty training, with ease.

If you’ve wondered:

“How often does my baby pee or poop?”

“When should I offer the potty to my little one?”

“If I want to set a potty time reminder on my phone, how long should I set it for?”

…The Log is your answer.

No more paper printouts and chicken-scratch logging, no more guessing “how often does my little actually pee or poop?”…now you can simply open the app and, starting at either waking or feeding, track how often your baby or toddler goes. Then download a PDF of your results.

*You can also take a note of your little one’s signals or other observations by long-pressing the activity button, as you go.

After starting potty training, or if you’re doing EC…after a few hours of observation time (or a few days if you’re really inquisitive)…visit the Reports screen to easily see your baby’s intervals in graph or written format.

Set a potty time alarm based on your baby’s actual timing intervals, so your smart phone can remind you throughout the day when to offer a “pottytunity” - or chance to go potty.

If you have a toddler you’re potty training or wrapping up EC with, you can use this app to set an alarm based on your observations - welcome to your new potty training alarm app!

Track one or more babies, keep the logs separate, and easily re-set the data to start a new observation sesh any time (I recommend you re-log your child’s rhythms every few months or so to keep it fresh!).

Stop over-offering and second-guessing yourself…and become a potty pro (or at least better than you were last week!) with this app.

Developed by me, Andrea Olson, author of Go Diaper Free and The Tiny Potty Training Book, whose 5 children were all out of diapers by walking, none requiring potty trained…a mom who has hardly had to change a poopy diaper and has saved over $10,000 in diapers across their babyhoods…you’re in good hands when it comes to observing your baby for elimination communication. Learn more at godiaperfree.com or via the app, itself.

PS - if you’re stinking at potty training, learn more with the free classes inside the app. If you don’t know what EC is, it’s the natural alternative to diaper dependence and potty training, and it starts as early as birth to 18 months. It’s what people have done for all of human history, long before diapers were invented. We also have a free class and books on that.

name: Pain Tracker - Pain Diary
description:
Pain Tracker is a chronic pain diary for the days that blur together, the flares nobody else can see, and the medication history your doctor needs but you cannot recall. Log where it hurts, how badly, what changed it, and walk into your next pain management visit with real data instead of a guess.

Built for adults managing chronic pain, neuropathic pain, low back pain, sciatica, neck pain, CRPS, fibromyalgia, post-surgical pain, cancer pain, neuropathy, radiculopathy, and central sensitization.

🎯 PAIN BODY MAP AND SEVERITY
Log pain the way your body actually feels it:
- Interactive body map with front and back views for precise location
- Pain radiation patterns and referred pain mapping
- NRS 0 to 10 severity scale with trend tracking
- Pain quality: burning, stabbing, aching, throbbing, electric, shooting, cramping
- Allodynia, hyperalgesia, numbness, and tingling flags
- Breakthrough pain events with timestamps
- Flare duration tracking from onset to resolution
- PEG scale for pain, enjoyment, and general activity

💊 MEDICATION AND TREATMENT TRACKING
Track every dose and response across your full regimen:
- Opioids: tramadol, hydrocodone, oxycodone, morphine, fentanyl patches, buprenorphine
- NSAIDs: ibuprofen, naproxen, celecoxib, meloxicam, diclofenac
- Neuropathic agents: gabapentin, pregabalin, duloxetine, amitriptyline, nortriptyline
- Muscle relaxants: cyclobenzaprine, baclofen, tizanidine, methocarbamol
- Topicals: lidocaine patches, capsaicin cream, diclofenac gel, menthol
- Steroid courses, nerve blocks, epidurals, trigger point injections
- Scheduled versus PRN versus breakthrough doses
- Time to relief and effectiveness ratings per dose
- Opioid taper tracking with dose reduction milestones
- Side effect logging and refill reminders

🔍 TRIGGERS AND FLARE PATTERNS
Identify what pushes you into a flare and what brings relief:
- Weather: barometric pressure, temperature, humidity changes
- Activity: overexertion, pacing failures, prolonged sitting or standing
- Stress: emotional events, work pressure, sleep loss
- Diet: inflammatory foods, alcohol, caffeine, skipped meals
- Hormonal cycle phase and PMDD windows
- Flare duration and recovery time tracking
- Custom triggers you discover over time

📊 FUNCTIONAL IMPACT AND ADL SCORES
Measure what pain takes and what you reclaim:
- Activities of daily living scores: walking, dressing, cooking, driving
- Hours worked, studied, or spent upright
- Sleep disruption: onset delay, night waking, unrefreshing sleep
- Mood impact: frustration, anxiety, catastrophizing, helplessness
- Social withdrawal and isolation tracking
- Step count and mobility from Health Connect
- Physical therapy exercises and home program adherence
- TENS, heat, ice, and complementary therapy sessions

📈 INSIGHTS AND DOCTOR REPORTS
Months of entries become evidence your pain team can act on:
- Pain trends across weeks and months
- Body map heatmaps showing affected regions over time
- Medication response timelines and breakthrough frequency
- Trigger correlation charts with statistical weight
- Function and sleep overlay graphs
- Flare frequency and average duration
- PDF and CSV reports for pain management, neurology, rheumatology
- One-tap sharing for appointments

🛡️ DESIGNED FOR HIGH-PAIN DAYS
- 30-second quick logging when pain is too high for detail
- Voice-to-text for hands-free entry
- Calm low-stimulation interface
- Offline mode for entries anywhere
- Optional passcode and biometric lock
- Encrypted cloud backup you control

Disclaimer: Pain Tracker is for informational and personal tracking use only. It is not a medical device and does not provide medical advice, diagnosis, or treatment. Always consult a qualified healthcare professional for medical concerns.

name: PainApp: Chronic Pain Relief
description:
Retrain Your Brain. Reclaim a Life Beyond Chronic Pain.
Still living with chronic back pain, neck pain, shoulder pain—or other persistent pain that just won’t go away? Your pain is real. But it may not be coming from where you think.

Requires Subscription.
Free to download; an active subscription is required to use the app and access all features.

Pain can be learned by the brain—and the good news is: it can also be unlearned. This app helps you understand how chronic pain works and gives you the tools to gently rewire the brain’s pain pathways.

How Does It Work?
Chronic pain often continues after the body has healed. Why? Because your brain has learned to protect you by activating pain—sometimes even without injury. This is called neural circuit pain, and it’s more common than most people realize.

By using science-backed methods based on neuroplasticity, our app helps you calm the brain’s danger signals, reduce pain, and restore a sense of safety in your body.

Education Is Treatment
Knowledge is so powerful, in fact, that education about pain is a medically recognized form of treatment. Healthcare practitioners call it therapeutic neuroscience education—which is a fancy way of saying that someone is learning how pain really works in the brain.

Scientific studies show that this kind of education can:

Reduce physical pain

Improve movement and function

Lower fear and anxiety

Calm the nervous system

Support long-term recovery

Understanding pain is often the first step to relieving it.

What You’ll Find Inside the App:
Daily science-based lessons to reframe your understanding of pain

Interactive pain tracker to identify patterns and monitor your progress

Guided practices to calm fear and deactivate pain circuits

Tools to identify neural circuit pain vs. structural pain

Strategies for responding to pain triggers with confidence

Exercises that promote safety, movement, and emotional ease

Gentle coaching on how to retrain your brain using proven techniques

Who Is This App For?
You might benefit from this approach if:

You have chronic back pain, neck pain, or shoulder pain

Your pain started during a stressful time or flares with stress

Your pain changes locations, intensity, or comes and goes

You’ve been told “there’s nothing wrong,” but still feel pain

You’ve tried everything—yet nothing has worked long-term

You’re open to a mind-body approach rooted in science, not guesswork

This app is designed for people ready to understand their pain, not just manage it.

Track, Learn, Improve
Our built-in pain tracker helps you:

Log and visualize your pain patterns over time

Notice emotional or situational triggers

Spot progress and build momentum

Feel more empowered in your recovery

No Meds. No Surgery. Just Science.
This is not about positive thinking or ignoring your pain. It’s about giving your brain the right information—and practicing how to respond with calm, not fear. Over time, this helps deconstruct the neural pathways that keep pain alive.

Download Now — Start Rewiring Pain, One Step at a Time
Train your brain. Understand your pain. Live your life again.

This app provides educational content and self-management tools and does not provide medical advice, diagnosis, or treatment. Consult a qualified healthcare professional for medical concerns.

Our virtual providers are available 24/7, 365 days a year, including weekends and holidays. Mental health appointments are often available within days—much faster than traditional providers who can take weeks

You’ll always see your exact visit cost upfront. We accept most insurance plans and partner with top employers and health plans to lower your costs. No insurance? Our telehealth visit costs are affordable.

Our US-based, board-certified doctors, licensed psychiatrists, and therapists have an average of 15 years of experience and come from diverse specialties to ensure you receive expert care.

SHIFT WORK MYTHS VS. CIRCADIAN SCIENCE

Shift workers face a serious biological challenge: misalignment between their internal circadian rhythms and their work schedules. This circadian disruption leads to insomnia, excessive sleepiness, poor performance, and increased long-term health risks.

Popular advice — like drinking more coffee, using supplements, or simply “getting more rest” — misses the mark. These approaches don’t address the root cause: your circadian misalignment.

It’s time to replace the myths with real science.

Generic tips won’t solve circadian disruption. Only evidence-based interventions that "reset" your circadian rhythms and manage circadian timing can effectively reduce the negative effects of shift work.

THE REAL SCIENCE OF SHIFT WORK

// In your brain, a circadian clock regulates the rhythm of your day.
// Shift work causes your sleep and other behaviors to occur at biologically inappropriate times, resulting in fatigue, poor sleep, and long-term health risks.
// Light is the most powerful cue for resetting your circadian clock. The correct timing of light exposure and light avoidance is the foundation of any circadian intervention to improve alertness and sleep quality. If your timing is off, it can make things worse.

WHY SHIFT WORKERS LOVE TIMESHIFTER

// Based on the latest sleep and circadian science

Wake tasks help make your alarm harder to ignore. You can choose a simple hold task, solve quick math challenges, or scan a saved barcode away from your bed to confirm you are awake.

Shifti also includes loud alarm protection, wake confirmation, snooze, reboot rescheduling, and progress tracking to help make your wake-up routine more reliable.

Why Shifti is different:

Most alarm clock apps only ring. Shifti helps you plan your sleep schedule before the alarm rings. It combines a gradual sleep schedule plan, bedtime reminders, wake tasks, and progress tracking so you can build consistency step by step.

Use Shifti to:

• Fix your sleep schedule gradually
• Stop waking up late
• Build a better morning routine
• Shift your bedtime earlier
• Wake up with a smarter alarm
• Reduce missed mornings
• Stay consistent after setbacks

name: SleepEngine
description:
Scientific sound technology for the SmartPillow by Cambridge Sleep Sciences.



Welcome to SleepEngine™ – the App which powers the Cambridge Sleep Sciences SmartPillow and enables you to enjoy better sleep using scientifically developed sound technology. Whether you suffer from insomnia, work alternative shift patterns, wake frequently during the night or are looking to optimise sleep for better physical and mental performance, SleepEngine™ technology can help improve your sleep and enhance your health and wellbeing.



WHAT IS SLEEPENGINE™ TECHNOLOGY?
This unique technology uses a neuroscientific approach to create sound waves which match the waves created by the adult brain during healthy sleep cycles. When any of the SleepEngine™ Sleep Programs are played, the sound waves (we call them Sleepsounds) guide your brain through the correct sequence of healthy sleep cycles so you can fall asleep quicker, stay asleep for longer and improve the overall quality of your sleep.
Poor sleep habits, lifestyle factors and other circumstances can disrupt healthy sleep patterns. Over time, your brain can forget the correct sequence of patterns and this is where difficulty falling and staying asleep can take hold. SleepEngine™ has been developed to retrain your brain to restore natural sleep patterns. And this all happens while you sleep!



HOW IT WORKS
The high quality pillow contains a small unit with two speakers inside. The SleepEngine™ App connects the unit to your smart device using Bluetooth. The App controls the unit and enables you to easily play your chosen Sleep Program, optional Soundscape and set your alarm, if required.
When playing the Sleepsounds, you will hear low frequency tones which guide you into sleep and encourage your brain to follow the sequence of healthy sleep cycles. When your chosen Sleep Program ends, you will wake up at the right point in the sleep cycle, refreshed and energised from improved sleep quality.
Regular and repeated use of SleepEngine™ will help to retrain your brain to produce the right sequence of sleep cycles and restore natural healthy sleep patterns.



PROVEN TECHNOLOGY
In two independent trials of the SleepEngine™ technology, featured in the SleepHub® sleep aid, 92%+ of users saw a positive improvement in their sleep and experienced on average per night, up to 2.5 hours more time per sleep per night and up to 1.5 less waking times.
SleepEngine™ technology, used in the SleepHub® sleep aid, has also received many positive reviews from the media and consumers around the world.



CHOICE OF SLEEP PROGRAMS & SOUND FEATURES
The SleepEngine™ App controls all the sound technology features of the SmartPillow. Once the App has been connected to the SmartPillow, you can personalise your sleep experience by choosing your preferred sleep settings. By experimenting with different settings, you can discover which ones help you to best fall asleep and stay asleep throughout the night.
There are 4 Sleep Programs to choose from:
Deep Sleep: a recommended 8-hour program which includes an 18 minute wake-up cycle and alarm
Easy Sleep: choose 2 to 8 hours of sleep when you don’t have enough time for the Deep Sleep program
Fall Asleep: a 2 hour program which guides you into deep sleep; ideal for those who struggle to get to sleep
Power Nap: provides an energising nap for 30, 45 or 60 minutes
You can further customise your sleep experience by playing relaxing and calming Soundscapes alongside the Sleepsounds. Choose from Ocean, Rain, Stream, Wind, Train and White, Pink and Brown Noise.
You can also set your preferred alarm sound from a selection of smooth and energetic options which enable you to wake up in the mood that suits you most.
Sound controls enable you to adjust your volume and balance levels, to ensure you achieve the optimal sleep experience using the SleepEngine™ technology.

PLANT JOURNAL

If you're looking for a way to keep track of your plant's life and get tips on how to care for them, Ploi is the plant app for you! With Ploi, you can log everything from when you watered your plant to when it started to bloom. Plus, our care guides are full of information on how to keep your plants healthy and happy.

GROWTH PROGRESS

If you're like most people, you probably have a few houseplants. Maybe you have a fiddle leaf fig tree or a peace lily. Perhaps you have a snake plant or a succulent. No matter what type of plant you have, it's important to document its growth.

One way to do this is to take photos of your plant at different stages of its life. For example, you might take a photo of your houseplant when you first get it, and then again after a month, and then every few months after that.

Another way to document your plant's growth is to keep a plant journal. In your journal, you can write about how your plant is doing, what changes you've noticed, and how you're caring for it.

Documenting your plant's growth is a great way to keep track of its progress and to create a plant log that you can look back on. Plus, it's a fun way to document your plant's journey from a small seedling to a full-grown plant!

FREE PLANT IDENTIFICATION

FREE PLANT CARE GUIDES

name: PlantNet Plant Identification
description:
Pl@ntNet is an application that allows you to identify plants simply by photographing them with your smartphone. Very useful when you don't have a botanist on hand! Pl@ntNet is also a great citizen science project: all the plants you photograph are collected and analysed by scientists around the world to better understand the evolution of plant biodiversity and to better preserve it.

Pl@ntNet allows you to identify and better understand all kinds of plants living in nature: flowering plants, trees, grasses, conifers, ferns, vines, wild salads or cacti. Pl@ntNet can also identify a large number of cultivated plants (in parks and gardens) but this is not its primary purpose. We especially need Pl@ntNet’s users to inventory the wild plants, those that you can observe in nature of course but also those that grow on the sidewalks of our cities or in the middle of your vegetable garden!

The more visual information you give to Pl@ntNet about the plant you are observing, the more accurate the identification will be. There are indeed many plants that look alike from afar and it is sometimes small details that distinguish two species of the same genus. Flowers, fruits and leaves are the most characteristic organs of a species and it is them that should be photographed first. But any other detail can be useful, such as thorns, buds or hair on the stem. A photograph of the whole plant (or the tree if it is one!) is also very useful information, but it is often not sufficient to allow a reliable identification.

At present Pl@ntNet makes it possible to recognize about 20,000 species. We are still a long way from the 360,000 species living on earth, but Pl@ntNet is getting richer every day thanks to the contributions of the most experienced users among you. Don't be afraid to contribute yourself! Your observation will be reviewed by the community and may one day join the photo gallery illustrating the species in the application.

The new version of Pl@ntNet released in January 2019 includes many improvements and new features:
- The ability to filter recognized species by genus or family.
- The differentiated data revision that gives more weight to users who have demonstrated the most skills (in particular the number of species observed, validated by the community).
- The re-identification of shared observations, whether yours or those of other users of the application.
- The multi-flora identification that allows you to search for the photographed plant in all the flora of the application and not only in the one you have selected. Very useful when you are not sure what flora to look for.
- The selection of your favorite floras to access them more quickly.
- The navigation at different taxonomic levels in image galleries.
- The mapping of your observations.
- Links to many factsheets.

The web version of the application is also available at the following address: https://identify.plantnet.org/

name: Partender – Fast Bar Inventory
description:
As featured on Paramount Network's "Bar Rescue" Partender is a patented, subscription-based business tool with a proprietary design that empowers you to:
- Do full, physical bar inventory in just 15 minutes and with up to 99.2% accuracy
- Split up the work across as many users as you'd like on iOS, Android, and even the web
- Generate editable "Smart Orders" based on what you actually went through
- Place, track, and receive those orders online
- Get alerted when prices change
- Get your Usage (for Variance)
- Get your Actual Cost of Goods Sold (COGS for Bev Cost %)
- See what’s trending in your venue such as Top Movers and Dead Stock

And besides saving time and labor, our customers:
1) Reduce Inventory Value On-Hand by 20-40%
2) Reduce Beverage Cost by 6-8%
3) Reduce Cost of Goods Fluctuation by 10%

...all in just 90 days of weekly use after setup.

Here’s what some of them had to say:

"Inventory takes less than 15 minutes now. It used to take 2 hours with 3 people counting, for a total of 6 labor hours."
- Grant S. at Boston Pizza

“It takes us just 15 minutes to do inventory, which we do at least twice a week. We stopped running out of things, and thanks to Partender, we managed to get beverage costs down to 20% in a matter of months."
- Mike W. at Marriott

How? Why?

Because when you count your inventory as accurately and as frequently as you count the cash in your register, less disappears. And the average shrinkage in our industry is 23% because no one's counting how much is there.

So when your inventory is 10-50x more valuable than your cash register, it makes sense to count it as carefully as the till, but that's been impossible until Partender.

So throw out your paper-and-pen and homegrown spreadsheets. Do inventory in minutes - not hours. See what's selling the best/worst, what's dead stock (and needs to get phased out via happy hour promotions), and what's about to run out and get 86'd (so you never miss a sale).

Stop manually typing your inventory into Excel or a glorified web-based spreadsheet. Let Partender streamline all of your inventory, ordering, and accounting operations in just 15 minutes a week.

With Partender, you can also:
- Monitor actual depletions
- See real-time customer insights for your actual customers on a per-product or per-category basis
- Instantly receive your Value On-Hand (like a "Balance Sheet") in wholesale and retail dollars after every inventory
- Optimize your par levels (based on online graphs) to buy more of what's selling the best and less of what's selling the worst
- Clearly understand why your cost of goods is going up (due to Price Change Alerts or due to shrinkage* via our Usage / Variance Report online

*Shrinkage is the loss of inventory due to over-pouring, theft, breakage, spillage, not tracking comps, etc. And there's an average 23% shrinkage in the industry which causes 60-80% of bars and restaurants to fail within 3 years. Or let significant amounts of revenue just walk out the door.

HOW DOES PARTENDER WORK?
Build a virtual "blueprint" of your venue after organizing your bar to split up the work of inventory across Main Bar, Back Bar, Stock Room, etc. Instead of manually writing down your inventory using an arbitrary 10-point scale, cumbersome scales, or expensive hardware, simply tap where the liquor level is on the real image of the bottle and swipe to the next bottle on your shelf. That's it! Our proprietary algorithms are up to 99.2% accurate so you know down to the drop & dollar-value how much each bottle is worth in Retail & Wholesale Dollars ($).

INVENTORY ANYTHING:
In addition to liquor, you can inventory beer, wine, smallwares, kegs, and FOOD! Our database is huge. If there's something on your shelf that's not in our database: take a picture of it, and our proprietary algorithms will do the rest.

ANALYTICS IN THE CLOUD:
Just log into your web dashboard to see COGS, beautiful graphs & trends of what customers are drinking in real-time.

name: NAIC Home Inventory
description:
The NAIC Home Inventory App makes it easy for you to upload photos and scan barcodes to quickly create a record of all your belongings. It also provides helpful tips around disaster mitigation and filing an insurance claim.

An accurate home inventory provides your insurance carrier with information about your insured losses.

CREATING YOUR HOME INVENTORY IS FAST AND EASY
• Group your belongings by room and categories
• Quickly take pictures of your belongings

BE PREPARED

FILING A CLAIM

ABOUT NAIC
Supporting Regulators & Insurance Standards in America since 1871. NAIC is the U.S. standard-setting and regulatory support organization created and governed by the chief insurance regulators.

We assist state insurance regulators, individually and collectively, in serving the public interest. We are driven by our members and their mission to protect consumers and ensure fair, competitive, and healthy insurance markets.

Consumer Protection

By providing unique, dedicated, and unparalleled resources and tools, we support an agile and effective state-based system of consumer protection. Visit NAIC.org for access to tools and resources to help you, as a consumer, understand different types of insurances, claims processes, and practical tips that can better support you at every stage of your life.

name: Board Game Tracker
description:
Board Game Tracker is an app for board game enthusiasts who want to keep all their play sessions, scores, and collection in one place. Track your progress, analyze your results, and discover new insights into your favorite titles.

Create and manage your personal game library. Analyze your scores with clear charts and statistics. Track your play history and always have quick access to information about which games you play most often and how your performance changes over time.

- 🎲 Play History - browse all your game sessions in one place.
- 📚 Game Collection - build your own library of games and mark which ones you own.
- 📊 Board Game Stats - analyze your performance.
- 📩 Import plays from BoardGameGeek.
- 💯 Scoring - record your scores and those of your friends.
- 🖇️ Share Results - share your scores with friends after each game.
- 👤 Friends - create profiles or invite friends.
- 📍 Locations - add places where you play.
- ⏱️ Time Tracking - record the duration of your games.
- 🗒️ Notes - add notes to your sessions.
- ☁️ Sync - transfer data between devices.
- 📸 Photos – add photos to your game sessions.
- 🕹️ Offline Mode - save results even without an Internet connection.

Start tracking your results and enjoy board games even more - with your history, collection, and clear statistics always at hand.

name: Board Game Stats
description:
With Board Game Stats (BG Stats for short) you can keep track of your collection, plays and scores in an easy to use tool.
View statistics and graphs for your games, plays, and other players.
Works offline, can sync with BoardGameGeek.

- How many games did you play recently?
- Who scored the highest for a game?
- With whom did you play and who wins more?
- Did you improve your score from last times?
- Use tailor-made score sheets to enter scores.
- Compare players, view graphs and charts.
- Keep track of your collection and sync with BoardGameGeek (BGG).

Collection management features of BG Stats:
- Keep track of every game you've played or are interested in.
- Choose a specific version and image, and track multiple copies.
- Set status to Owned, Wishlist, Want to play, and much more.
- Enter details like comments, price paid, acquisition date, etc.
- Filter games on status, Played but not owned, Unplayed owned.
- Set Custom filters to select a game for your specific group.
- Full automatic syncing with your BoardGameGeek (BGG) collection.

Play tracking features:
- Set scoring rules, cooperative and team play for each game.
- Select game and played expansions.
- Set Players and Locations, including anonymous players.
- Enter location, scores per player and many more details.
- Calculate scores on the fly by using + and - signs.
- Create teams and enter team scores.
- Use over 2500 game-specific tailor-made score sheets.
- Add Player roles, and choose from previously used ones.
- Use a timer to keep track of your play length.
- Add a Game note you can view each time you start a Play.
- Post your plays to BoardGameGeek (BGG), including auto-post after each save.
- Import existing plays from BoardGameGeek, Yucata, Board Game Arena (BGA) and ScorePal.
- Send one or more Plays to other BG Stats users so only one of you has to enter it.

Statistics features:
- View statistics for each game and player, and combination.
- See pie charts, play times and durations graphs, and score charts.
- View insights for Games and Players, for different time periods.
- See your with H-index, fives, dimes, quarters and centuries.
- View a Player's personal H-index and win percentage.
- Share Insights charts and 3x3 images.
- See cost per play for your games.

BG Stats has export and import functions for easy backup to a variety of services.
You can sync with other devices via BG Stats Cloud sync (an in-app subscription).
All in a native interface, supporting dark mode on Android 10+, landscape and tablet screens.

With the Power Expansion (in-app purchase):
- Extended game charts, based on number of players.
- Filter your data on players, locations, specific periods and player counts.
- Statistics for a specific combination of players, and compare them.
- Winning streaks, tiebreakers, and new and starting players stats.
- Role- and board-based statistics.
- Heat map of plays and play duration.
- Cost per hour, player and more.
- Add tags to Games, Players and Locations.
- Create and save custom filters, now also with tags.
- Customize the Game filter dropdown menu.
- Create advanced filters with multiple criteria and logical operations.
- View combined game statistics.
- Sync game tags with BoardGameGeek.
- Create Challenges (if available) based on game filters or tags.

With the Challenges expansion (in-app purchase):
- Create a challenge from one of the many templates.
- x times y challenges: play x games y times.
- Ongoing Reach your next H-index challenges.
- Set the time period and choose specific games to track, or use auto-fill.
- Filter specific Players, Locations and player counts to count for the challenge.

With a Cloud sync subscription:
- Seamlessly sync your data between all your devices.
- Keep a backup of your data in the cloud.

Please note that any changes to the BGG website or API can temporarily break BGG related features. I cannot guarantee their continued availability.

name: My Board Game Collection
description:
What if you could have all the information about your boardgames in one beautiful location?
Not only the data coming from the online database (BoardGameGeek), but also your custom data & play sessions.

What if it could translate the information to any language?
We have systems at our fingertips that allow us to translate to any language in the world. We use those systems to allow you to translate descriptions & comments.

By making use of BoardGameGeek & BoardGameAtlas we are able to give you an enourmous amount of information about your collection and/or about board games you want to check out.

No database is perfect so we created a way for you to add to the existing data.
You can add videos (f.e.: how to play), website urls (f.e.: alternate play rules), images (f.e.: your pictures), your notes, game language, tags, purchase date & purchase price and more.

Finding new boardgames can be very exciting, so we are giving you options to be able to find cool new games.
You can view dynamic lists and you can search the database with various filters. Search filters like player count, age, play time, ...

Choosing a boardgame to play is not always easy, that is why we give you multiple options to filter your collection: name, cooperative play, number of players, playtime, release year, is digital, difficulty, tags or/and a favorite.

Even with all these filters it can be hard to choose, some people just have a lot of very cool games in their collection. For these situations we have added a 'pick random' action to the list.

We are a strong believer in open formats so My Board Game Collection uses an open format for its backup/restore files.

Log your play sessions and keep track of what, when and where you played. You can also log who played and who won and with what score. Never forget.

My Board Game Collection is fully usable in its free form, but creating an app requires a huge amount of time and resources. To be able to support My Board Game Collection going forward we have added ads & a couple of premium features. You can remove the ads and unlock the premium features in 2 ways:
1. FREE: You can watch reward videos that will give you ad free time with the app. This ad free time can also be used to use PREMIUM features.
2. PAID: An single in app purchase is available to remove all ads and unlock all premium features.

PREMIUM Features:
- Remove all ads.
- Search images using our in app search screen.
- Change the limit of 2 score / health / resource tracker to unlimited.
- Enable the 'fast jump' on the bottom of the boardgame list.

Check out our social channels to see what is coming, show your support or tell us about any suggestions you might have.
Also available on other platforms. Check out our social channels for more info.

name: Root Board Game
description:
Play the digital adaptation of the beloved tabletop board game. Root is a game of adventure and war where 2 to 4 players battle for control of a vast wilderness.

The nefarious Marquise de Cat has seized the great woodland, intent on harvesting its riches. Under her rule, the many creatures of the forest have banded together. This Alliance will seek to strengthen its resources and subvert the rule of Cats. In this effort, the Alliance may enlist the help of the wandering Vagabonds who are able to move through the more dangerous woodland paths. Though some may sympathize with the Alliance’s hopes and dreams, these wanderers are old enough to remember the great birds of prey who once controlled the woods.

Meanwhile, at the edge of the region, the proud, squabbling Eyrie have found a new commander who they hope will lead their faction to resume their ancient birthright.

The stage is set for a contest that will decide the fate of the great woodland. It is up to the players to decide which group will ultimately take root.

name: Clue: Official Hasbro Game
description:
Join fellow detectives all over the world in the official digital board game version of Clue! Gather crucial evidence, interrogate suspects and solve the original murder mystery.

Follow Miss Scarlett, Colonel Mustard, Professor Plum, Chef White, Solicitor Peacock and Mayor Green through the iconic Tudor Mansion, unlocking their motives and alibis as you go.

Enjoy Clue the way you remember it in Classic Mode, or jump in for a quick game with Clue Cards mode. Alternatively, if you want to really test your sleuthing skills, try a new investigation format available exclusively to Clue – Ultimate Detective.

In Ultimate Detective Mode, everyone answers suggestions at the same time…but secretly!

Face your suspects in a direct interrogation as you rely on your skills of deduction to get to the truth. Experience the mystery, solve the murder and become a top-tier detective!

HOW TO PLAY CLUE:

1. Three cards are dealt face-down and set aside – this is the solution to the crime!
2. Everyone is dealt three Clue Cards. These are automatically crossed off your clue sheet, as they can’t be part of the solution.
3. Roll the dice and move around the board.
4. When you enter a room, you can make a suggestion – select who you think the murderer is, what weapon they used and where the crime happened.
5. Other players will then aim to disprove your suggestion; if one of your suggestions matches a card in their hand, they show you that card to disprove it.
6. Use your clue sheet to keep track of which characters, weapons and rooms have been disproven.
7. Think you’ve figured it out? It’s time to make an accusation! Be careful though – if you’re right, you win, but if you are wrong, you’re out!

FEATURES

- THE CLASSIC TUDOR MANSION – Play the beloved original board game, now rendered in stunning 3D animation and entirely ad-free!
- A BRAND-NEW GAME MODE – Exclusive to the digital version of Clue, Ultimate Detective Mode lets you interrogate multiple characters at once.
- MULTIPLE MODES – Compete against advanced AI opponents that adjust to your skill level for the ideal game, or challenge detectives worldwide.
- ADDITIONAL ORIGINAL CONTENT – What happened after the shocking events of Tudor Mansion? Find out in a series of original new crime scenes designed specifically for the digital version of Cluedo! New characters emerge, bringing with them new clues, motives and case files to consider as you travel around the world in search of the truth.

Sharpen your mind with the iconic murder-mystery board game, now available on mobile!

CLUEDO and HASBRO and all related trademarks and logos are trademarks of Hasbro, Inc. © 2025 Hasbro.

name: BoardGameGeek
description:
This is the official app for BoardGameGeek, an online resource and community that aims to be the definitive source for board game and card game content. Daily new content, continuously updated by millions of passionate users, makes ‘the Geek’ the largest and most up-to-date place to get gaming information. You can become a registered member of BoardGameGeek (BGG) for free, and we welcome your contributions in the form of ratings, reviews, and thoughts on games!

BGG features reviews, ratings, images, play-aids, translations, and session reports from board game geeks around the world, as well as live discussion forums.

Here you’ll find many types of board games, including thousands you’ve probably never seen in a store. We cover not only board games but also dice games, card games, tile-laying games, and games of dexterity. We have abstracts, economic games, dungeon crawls, city building, diplomacy and negotiation, trading, puzzle games, strategy games, party games, war games, and many more. We run the gamut from the light and whimsical Carcassonne to the serious and heavy empire-building of Twilight Imperium: Fourth Edition. Well-known games like Monopoly exist in the database as well, although you’ll find almost all users prefer modern games that exhibit advancements in game play and component quality since Monopoly was first published.

Ad-blocking subscription
When you purchase ‘AdBlock for Android’ you enjoy an ads-free experience in the app (except for embedded web views). Payment will be charged on a recurring monthly or annual basis. Your monthly or annual AdBlock subscription will automatically renew unless you cancel at least 24 hours before your subscription ends. Cancel anytime in your device’s Account Settings. No partial refunds.

Privacy policy: https://boardgamegeek.com/privacy
Terms of Service: https://boardgamegeek.com/terms
Community Guidelines: https://boardgamegeek.com/community_rules

Welcome to the board gaming community. Stay for a while. Stay forever...

name: Board Club
description:
Step into the world of classic board games with Board Club! This all-in-one gaming hub brings together Ludo , Carrom ,Chess ,TicTacToe, Block Puzzle, Tile Master, Dot and Box ,Connect 4 ,Polygon Merge , 2048 ,3 Guti , 16 Guti , Dice Down , SOS, Dominoes and Snake Ladder 15+ of your beloved offline board games, ensuring endless entertainment for players of all ages. From strategic showdowns in Chess and Connect 4 to nostalgic fun with Ludo and Carrom, Board Club offers an array of timeless games that have captured hearts for generations.

Immerse yourself in brain-teasing challenges like Block Puzzle, Tile Master, and 2048, or engage in friendly matches of Tic Tac Toe and Dot and Box. Experience traditional cultural games like 3 Guti and 16 Guti, showcasing the rich heritage of strategic gameplay. With Dice Down and SOS, test your quick thinking and communication skills.

Board Club is your passport to reliving cherished moments with family and friends. Say goodbye to the hassle of carrying multiple game boxes – everything you need is now conveniently available in one app. Plus, stay excited for upcoming updates that promise even more offline board games to enhance your gaming experience.

Key Features:
🎲 Access 15+ classic offline board games all in one app.
🏆 Challenge yourself with favorites like Ludo, Carrom, and Chess.
🧩 Test your skills in brain-teasing games like Block Puzzle and Tile Master.
🔥 Engage in strategic battles with Connect 4, Polygon Merge, and 2048.
🌟 Experience traditional games like 3 Guti, 16 Guti, and Dice Down.
💡 Exercise your wit with Dot and Box and enhance your communication with SOS.
🚀 Anticipate exciting updates with even more offline board games on the horizon.

Download Board Club now and open the door to a world of classic board game excitement. Reignite your passion for strategic gameplay, create lasting memories with loved ones, and embark on a journey of fun and camaraderie. Your favorite board games have found their new home – right in the palm of your hand.

name: Mouse Trap: Hasbro Board Game
description:
Stop what you’re fonduing – Mouse Trap is back with a snap!

Choose your mouse, your outfit and get ready for the cheesiest race of your life!

Strategise on the fly as you pick up cheese, steal cheese, and win with the most cheese! Need to slow down another player? Activate the mouse trap and watch the famous chain reaction unfold!

Will it work? Only one way to find out!

At the end of every game, the cheese you earn is added to your hoard. Use your hard-earned cheese to unlock even more outfits for your mouse, and get ready to show off your new look in the next game!

Ready? Set? Go!

FEATURES:
- MULTIPLE MODES – Bring your friends and family together for a race to collect all the cheese!
- DRESS UP YOUR MOUSE – Choose your favourite colour! Pick from red, blue, yellow and green mice, then add your favourite outfit to bring your mouse to life.
- ONLINE AND OFFLINE PLAY – Play against epic A.I. opponents in Single Player Mode, challenge your friends, head online to face fans around the world, or use Pass & Play Mode and simply pass the controller between players!
- UNLOCK MORE OUTFITS – At the end of every game, the cheese you have is added to your hoard. Use your cheese to unlock new outfits!

Race into the colourful, fun and immersive world of Mouse Trap today. It’s as fun as only cheese can brie!

name: Catan Universe
description:
Play your favorite game CATAN anytime and anywhere: the original board game, the card game, the expansions and ‘CATAN – Rise of the Inkas‘, all in one app!

After a long voyage of great deprivation, your ships have finally reached the coast of an uncharted island. However, other explorers have also landed on Catan: The race to settle the island has begun!

Build roads and cities, trade skillfully and become Lord or Lady of Catan!

Go on a journey to the Catan universe, and compete in exciting duels against players from all over the world. The board game classic and the Catan card game bring a real tabletop feeling to your screen!

Play with your Catan Universe account on the device of your choice: You can use your login on numerous desktop and mobile platforms! Become part of the huge worldwide Catan community, and compete against players from all over the world, and on all supported platforms.

The board game:
Play the basic board game in multiplayer mode! Join two of your friends for a maximum of three players and face all the challenges in “Arrival on Catan”.

Make things even more exciting by unlocking the full Basegame, the expansions “Cities & Knights” and “Seafarers”, each for up to six players. The special scenario pack containing the scenarios “Enchanted Land” and “The Great Canal” adds even more variety to your games.

The game edition ‘Rise of the Inkas‘ is another exciting challenge for you, as your settlements are doomed in their heyday. The jungle swallows the signs of human civilization, and your opponents seize their chance to build their settlement at the location they crave for.

The card game:
Play the introductory game of the popular 2 player card game “Catan – The Duel” online free of charge or master the free “Arrival on Catan”, to permanently unlock the single player mode against the AI.

Get the complete card game as an in-game purchase to play three different theme sets against friends, other fans friends or different AI opponents and submerge yourself into the bustling life on Catan.


Features:

- Trade – build – settle – Become Lord of Catan!
- Play on all your devices with one account.
- Faithful to the original version of the board game “Catan”, as well as the card game “Catan – The Duel” (aka “Rivals for Catan”)
- Design your own avatar.
- Chat with other players and form guilds.
- Participate in seasons and win amazing prizes.
- Play to earn numerous achievements and unlock rewards.
- Get additional expansions and play modes as in-game purchases.
- Get started very easily with the comprehensive tutorial.


Free-to-play content:

- Basic game free matches against two other human players
- Introductory game free matches Catan – The Duel against a human player
- “Arrival on Catan”: Master the challenges in all areas of the game to get more red Catan suns.
- You can use Catan suns to play against the computer. Your yellow suns recharge on their own.

Minimum Android version: Android 4.4.

We are looking forward to your feedback!

Whether it's board games, card games, dice games, or a pub quiz, Score Counter keeps the score for you. It's a favorite for games like Scrabble, Rummy, Yahtzee, Canasta, darts, and golf — and works with virtually any game where you add up points.

**Key Features:**
* **Game Templates:** Save your favorite game setups (players, rules, target score) and start new games in seconds.
* **Template Statistics:** Track player standings, win rates, and score trends over time. Filter by date range to see who's been on a hot streak.
* **Cloud Backup & Sync (Premium):** Sign in with Google or Apple to keep your games, players and stats safely backed up and synced across devices.
* **Advanced Game Rules:** Set a **target score** or **round limit** to automatically finish the game. Toggle **reverse scoring** for games where lower points are better. Choose a **starting player** and optionally rotate each round.
* **Initial Score:** Set a starting score for all players — perfect for games that begin with a point balance.
* **Player Rankings:** See final placements, track live ranking during the game, and resume a finished game any time.
* **Player Management:** Easily add, edit, and reorder players.
* **History:** View detailed history of all played games. Search and filter by status (still playing/finished). Check the current game leaderboard.
* **Data Export & Import:** Back up your data or analyze it on your PC. Export games (single or batch), players, and templates to **CSV** or **JSON**. Seamlessly import data back from JSON. Exported files are auto-saved to Downloads.
* **Custom Toolbars:** Create your own score input toolbars with the buttons you use most.
* **Customization:** Choose between Dark, Light, or System theme, and adjust contrast levels for better visibility.
* **Intuitive Interface:** Show or hide round numbers and interim results as needed.
* **Score Editing:** Made a mistake? Just tap a score to edit it.

Score Counter replaces pen, paper, and calculator. Focus on the game, not the math!

- Per-player thinking time (Pro)
- Per-turn time limit with vibration and alarm (Pro)
- Chess clock with Fischer/Bronstein increment (Pro)
- Win-rate charts and streaks (Pro)
- Direct player comparison – head-to-head (Pro)

- Backdate matches you forgot to log

PAY ONCE, USE FOREVER

Free for up to 3 game sets — with unlimited matches, full match history and all four scoring modes. No ads, no subscription.

Pro is a one-time purchase (no subscription!) and unlocks unlimited game sets plus the complete analysis layer: per-player stopwatch, per-turn time limit, full statistics, head-to-head, cross-game ranking.

No subscription. No ads. No accounts. No cloud. Everything stays local on your device.

MADE FOR

- Weekly game nights with the same group

- Chess clubs and casual players
- D&D groups with session logs

  • Receiving and putaway

  • Retail backroom checks and shelf replenishment

  • Picking, packing, and shipping verification

Why teams choose Mobile Inventory

It is fast to set up, easy to learn, and flexible enough for both quick stock checks and structured warehouse inventory workflows. Whether you need easy stock counting for one device or accurate team stock counts across multiple users, Mobile Inventory helps you scan faster, count accurately, and keep inventory organized across Android, iOS, and Web.

description:
NO TIME TO COOK?

Do you often eat unhealthily due to lack of time? Order delivery too often? Spend too much money on food? Meal Prep Master shows you how to eat healthier through smart meal prepping while saving time and money – the 21-day course for meal prep beginners.

WHAT IS MEAL PREP?

Meal prep is the art of strategic batch cooking. Instead of wondering daily what to eat, you cook once a week in advance. The result: Healthy meals ready to go, less stress, more money.

Common problems without meal prep:
- Daily question: What do I eat today?
- Too much money on delivery services
- Unhealthy fast food out of convenience
- Food spoiling in the fridge
- Fitness goals failing due to poor nutrition

Benefits of meal prep:
- Save 5-10 hours per week
- Save up to $200 per month
- Eat healthier without daily effort
- Achieve your fitness goals easier
- Less food waste

THE 21-DAY COURSE

In 21 days you'll become a meal prep pro:

Week 1 – Basics:
- Understand meal prep principles
- Learn to create weekly plans
- Create your first shopping list
- Prepare your first meals

Week 2 – Techniques:
- Batch cooking for multiple portions
- Time-saving cooking techniques
- Proper storage and shelf life
- Art of portioning

Week 3 – Routine:
- Build your personal meal prep routine
- Adapt weekly plan to your lifestyle
- Strategies for on-the-go
- Solidify healthy habits

FEATURES

- Daily lessons with practical tips
- Interactive exercises and checklists
- Quick help for cravings
- Shopping list templates
- Progress tracking with streak system
- Bonus exercises for advanced users
- 100% offline available
- No registration – complete privacy

START FREE

3 introductory lessons are completely free.

YOUR DATA STAYS WITH YOU

All data only on your device. No cloud, no registration, no tracking.

Ready for stress-free, healthy eating? Download now!

description:
Scaling, planner and grocery list for bakers, pastry chefs and food businesses.

_______________________________________________

You bake every day. But the math never ends. Cookara replaces the spreadsheets, notebooks and mental load with one system that does the calculating for you.

Add your recipes once and keep your whole kitchen in one place. Cookara handles the math from there.

Cookara helps bakers, pastry chefs, chefs and small food businesses handle the most important parts of kitchen work:

• scale recipes instantly

• update ingredient prices automatically
• plan production by date
• generate grocery lists
• import recipes from photos and PDFs
• calculate tiered cake weight and portions
• track nutrition and calories
• build recipes from sub-recipes
• keep kitchen data in one organized system

• Scale recipes instantly

Every time something changes, the math starts over. You grab the calculator, redo the numbers, write them down — and hope you didn't make a typo. Cookara does that part for you.

Change the baking batch size, the diameter, the weight — and every ingredient updates automatically.


• Calculate recipe cost

You set the price by feel because there's no time to calculate every time. And then you wonder why the work doesn't pay off.

Update one ingredient price — and Cookara recalculates the cost of every recipe that uses it.

Know what your products actually cost. Price them with confidence. Keep your profit.


• Plan production by date

You know what needs to be made this week. But it lives in your head — and heads forget.

Add recipes to your planner for specific dates. See exactly what you're baking and when. Your whole week, out of your head and into one place.


• Generate grocery lists

Your planner knows what you're making. Cookara knows what you need to buy.

Add recipes to your plan — one tap and your grocery list is ready. Every ingredient, every quantity, calculated automatically.

No forgotten ingredients. No last-minute runs to the store.


• Import recipes from photos and PDFs

You already have recipes. They're just not in the right place yet.

Photo, PDF or text — Cookara pulls out the ingredients and quantities for you. Your existing recipes are ready to use without retyping a single line.


• Calculate tiered cake weight and portions

Different diameter. Different height. Different tier.

Every time the cake size changes, you start the math over. Cookara calculates the size, weight and portions of the cake and every tier automatically — and connects each one to its recipe.

Clients ask about calories. And you don't have the answer.

Cookara has a built-in database of 3500 ingredients with nutritional values. Calories, protein, fat and carbs for every bakery recipe are calculated automatically — per serving, per unit, per 100g. The answer is ready before they even ask.

A cake is not one recipe. It's a sponge, a cream, a filling — each a separate building block.

Create components once and combine them into any dessert.


You started this because you love what you make. Cookara makes sure the math doesn't get in the way.

name: Recipe Scale Converter
description:

* Dashboard Overview
- View the total number of ingredients and the current scale factor at a glance.
- Navigate to Ingredients, Scale Factor, or Results sections quickly.

* Data Management
- Reset all ingredients and scale factor to default from the settings screen.

* Privacy
- This app operates entirely offline.
- No data is collected, stored remotely, or shared.
- All information remains on your device only.

* Clean Minimal Design
- Card-based layout with intuitive navigation.
- Splash screen on launch.

This app does NOT include cloud sync, AI features, smart notifications, recipe storage, or any online functionality. It is a simple, local recipe scaling calculator.

name: SuperCook - Recipe Generator
description:
How many times have you found yourself looking for that perfect recipe – only to find that you’re missing one or more ingredients?

How many times have you opened the fridge and thought to yourself -- what can I make ?

How many times have you thrown away an ingredient, because you couldn't figure out how to use it before it expired ?

SuperCook to the rescue!

Unlike other recipe apps, SuperCook only shows you recipes that require the ingredients you already have.

All the recipes you see on SuperCook are recipes you can make right now. No more inconvenient grocery runs for a missing ingredient, at a time when you should be home, with your family and friends

Why purchase new ingredients when you can focus on what you already have?

Here’s how it works:
• For Supercook to do its magic, it needs to know all the ingredients you have at home.
• Visit the pantry page in the SuperCook app and choose from a list of 2000+ ingredients broken down into categories like fruits, vegetables, meats, and many more.
• Start adding ALL the ingredients you have at home to your SuperCook pantry – including oils, spices, and yes - even that old bottle of Worcestershire sauce in the back of the fridge!
• Sit back and watch SuperCook work its magic by finding recipes that match your ingredients.

SuperCook’s Unique App Features:

--Customized Recipe Ideas--
We’ve consolidated over 11 million recipes from 18,000 recipe websites, in 20 languages to create the largest recipe collection ever. This knowledge was fed into an AI system that learnt the intricacies of all ingredients and how they can be mixed together.

All you have to do is build your pantry on the app – and you’re ready to make delicious meals without ever leaving your house!

SuperCook will find you any recipe you need, whether it’s for breakfast, lunch, dinner, or even a midnight snack.

--Easily Add Your Ingredients--
Save time and money with an intelligent pantry. SuperCook’s voice dictation mode allows you to quickly add ingredients to your in-app pantry by simply saying them out loud.

Just open your fridge, click the microphone button, and start listing everything inside. The app will automatically add the ingredients to your pantry for a quick and easy way to find recipes!

--Automatic Recipe Recommendations--
The app will automatically find you recipes to make with what’s in your fridge – so all those lost ingredients in the back of your cupboard now have a place on your table. It’s that simple!

When you run out of an ingredient, simply open the SuperCook app and remove it from your pantry - and all the recipe ideas will adjust accordingly.

--Get Creative in the Kitchen--
SuperCook inspires new ideas and activities in the kitchen for new cooks, busy parents, foodies, and pro chefs alike.

With over 11 million recipes available in 20 different languages, SuperCook promises that you’ll never cook the same thing twice (unless you want to, of course!).

--What's on the menu ?--
The menu page is where you'll find all your recipe ideas. Why is it called menu? Because just like the menu in a restaurant, everything on the menu page is available to you now. SuperCook instantly analyzes 11 million recipes and finds the ones that match your unique ingredients.

Most likely your menu page will contain thousands of recipes, but don't worry, we've broken them down into helpful categories like soups and stews, appetizers and snacks, salads, entrees, desserts and more.

--Reduce food waste--
Most people don't realize how much food they throw away every day — from uneaten leftovers to spoiled produce. SuperCook is one of the best ways to reduce food waste in the home. It finds recipes that use as many of your ingredients as possible, so nothing goes to waste. SuperCook makes food waste prevention fun and easy, just open the menu page on the app and choose a recipe. We help you use what you have, so nothing goes to waste!

name: Calculation of recipes
description:
A smart book to record your recipes. Thanks to a variety of functions, you can:
- count products;
- find out the energy value and calorie content;
- change the number of servings and the shape of the dish for cooking;
- count the weight of all products according to the recipe;
- estimate the approximate cost of cooking according to the recipe;
- etc.

Create your own recipes and attach photos to them.

The application contains a database of products with more than 3000 items. Each product contains information about calories and energy value. Using these products, you can create your own recipes, and the app will count the calorie content for you.

If the product is not in the database, then you can easily add it. You can also edit existing products.

More detailed:

- 1 mode -
You have a recipe that requires 500 ml of milk, and you only have 300 ml. Write down the quantity of any product, and the application will recalculate the quantity of all other products. The new recipe is ready.

- 2 mode -
You have found a recipe where a baking dish with a diameter of 21 cm is used, and you only have a 16 cm mold. Fill in the required fields in this mode and cook in the form that you have. In addition, it is possible to recalculate not only the round shape, but also the rectangular one.

- 3 mode -
Some recipe is designed for, say, 6 servings, and you want to cook for 4 servings. Specify the number of servings in a special column and get the number of products you will need.

- 4 mode -
The mode is suitable for those cases when you want to know the weight of the dish.

- 5 mode -
One click on this mode, and you get information about the calorie content of 100 grams of the dish, the 1st serving and the whole dish.

Besides that:

- several dozen recipes are already waiting for you in this application;
- there is an autofill function, when when writing recipes you will be offered products from the database;
- it is possible to divide recipes by category;
- it is possible to enable and disable the cost calculation mode;
- it is possible to enable or disable the display of the energy value of products.

Full version of the app:

Most of the app's functions work both in the full version of the app and in the free version. By purchasing the full version of the app you get the following benefits:

- no unobtrusive advertising;
- the content of proteins, fats and carbohydrates is displayed in the product database;
- additional features when working with the database;
- all preset recipes are available.

There are currently three subscription options available:
- 1 month for 20 rubles (in terms of the currency of your country);
- 3 months for 40 rubles (in terms of the currency of your country);
- 12 months for 80 rubles (in terms of the currency of your country);

The payment is debited from your account account upon confirmation of purchase. The subscription is automatically renewed if you do not cancel it at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. The subscription renewal fee is debited from the account within 24 hours before the end of the current period.

The user can manage their subscription. To disable auto-renewal, open your account settings after purchase. If you cancel an existing subscription, no refund will be made for the remaining period before its end.

You can also purchase the full version of the application by making a one-time payment of 250 rubles (in terms of the currency of your country). The payment is made once and provides access to the full version for an unlimited time.

Simple interface and nice graphics will help you to learn how to use this application without any problems.

A psychological diary is a highly effective self-help practice


Psychologists recommend keeping a psychological diary. It can be an emotion tracker, a mood diary a CBT journal, or free-form entries.


As the best self-help practice, it will help you:


  • Better understand yourself, your thoughts, feelings, reactions, and relationships with other people

  • Express emotions and experiences, rather than suppressing them, and ensure better emotional regulation and stress reduction

  • Approach problem-solving and decision-making mindfully

  • Identify sources of stress and anxiety and find ways to cope with them

  • Improve personal development and growth

Self-help practices you will find in this mental health therapy app


Negative situations diary


A Negative Situations Diary is a very effective self-help technique for solving psychological problems. It will help you cope with painful and anxious moments more easily, understand how some events affect your feelings and mood, and strategize your reactions for similar situations in the future.


Make entries about every negative moment, track your thoughts, mark emotions, and select a cognitive distortion. With this therapy journal, you can better understand yourself, your behavior, and your feelings associated with a specific event. Help yourself to free your mind from negativity, and feel much better. By changing your approach to resolving negative situations, your reaction to them will also change.


Positive moments diary


In the Positive Moments Diary (Gratitude Journal), you can write down all your positive events, good emotions, and gratitude. It helps you pay attention to the pleasant moments and, thus, reduce stress and other negative feelings.


Everything that causes positive emotions truly matters. So, use these positive emotions for self-help mindfully. Whether you had a significant event or something fleeting, write it down and mark the emotions you experienced. And motivate yourself.


Morning diary


With the Morning Diary, you can help yourself set up for the day ahead and free your mind from needless worries, irrational anxieties, and negativity. By practicing this morning diary and mood tracker, you will notice how your energy, motivation, awareness, and creativity rise.


Write down your emotions, feelings, experiences, plans, tasks, goals, and desires every day, immediately after you wake up. Write down everything that seems important to you at that moment.


Evening diary


An Evening Diary is an effective self-help practice. With it, you can track your emotions, feelings, and thoughts at the end of the day, right before going to bed. With this mental health tracker, you can analyze your day and get rid of unfounded worries, stress and tension, anxiety & depression. All this helps you relax, sleep better, and recover.


Write down your events and impressions of the past day. Describe your emotions, feelings, self-esteem, and physical condition in detail. Write down the lesson you learn from this day. Don't try to write it correctly, just be honest and record things you believe to be important for you at that moment.


Download Moodi, a CBT therapy journal and mental health tracker. Put one of the most effective self-help practices on your service. Trace and analyze your negative situations and positive moments, and keep a morning journal and evening mood diary. Learn to save and cherish positive feelings and get rid of anxiety & depression.

description:
KnowDrugs is the easiest way to lookup drug testing results, pill warnings and drug alerts and provides you with drug info about more than 200 drugs, along with advice on harm reduction and safer use. Taking drugs always involves risks - however, if you do decide to take drugs, KnowDrugs can help you to take appropriate measures to reduce potential harms.

DRUG INFORMATION & EDUCATION

Check the profiles of more than 200 drugs for educational purposes: Stimulants like MDMA and Amphetamine, depressants such as Alcohol and Benzodiazepines or psychedelics like 2C-B, LSD and DMT.

KnowDrugs provides you with drug education harm reduction advice, focusing on MDMA / Molly / Ecstasy and other psychoactive substances. Knowing about the wanted and unwanted effects of drugs, their duration, interactions and risks helps you to make more informed decisions, reduce risks and reflect upon your drug habits and consumption behaviour.

DRUG CHECKING, PILL WARNINGS & DRUG ALERTS

Search for drug name, substance or location, to find drug alerts from nearby and learn about their ingredients and dosage strength to avoid overdose and particularly dangerous cuts (e.g. PMA).

Drug checking or pill testing is a way to reduce the harm from drug consumption by allowing users to find out the content and purity of substances that they intend to consume. This empowers users to make safer choices: to avoid more dangerous substances and combination and to use smaller quantities.

If you don't have access to professional drug testing services, looking up recent drug testing results can still help you make a more informed decision about your consumption.

HARM REDUCTION & RESPONSIBLE DRUG USE

Harm reduction aims to minimize the harms associated with recreational substance use. The harm reduction approach follows from the idea that substance use is a high-risk activity that innately entails the possibility of injury, addiction, and death. Therefore, the best strategy one can employ (outside of avoiding use entirely) is to take appropriate measures to mitigate its potential harms.

KnowDrugs highlights the harm-potential of more than 200 substances and demonstrates strategies on how to reduce the harms associated with the consumption of drugs.

KNOWDRUGS CAN ALSO HELP YOU TO:

- learn how to spot and react in case of an emergency, take care of someone experiencing a bad trip at a party or festival
- find a free and confidential counselling service which accepts you and your personal choices, and helps you develop the right strategies and competencies if you want to change something about your consumption behaviour.

description:
It’s your medication, only cheaper. RxSaver™ lets you search for your prescription drug in seconds and finds you the cheapest prices at nearby pharmacies, so there are no surprises at the pharmacy counter.

RxSaver is free to use. No membership or sign in required. Whether you have insurance or not, you could be saving on your Rx medications.

Using RxSaver is as easy as 1-2-3.
1. 🔍Enter your medication in the app
2. 💊Get free Rx coupons to use at your pharmacy
3. 🎉Celebrate your savings. You’re now an RxSaver!

Where is RxSaver Accepted?
RxSaver coupons are accepted at all major U.S. pharmacies including: Walgreens, Walmart, CVS, Costco, Rite Aid, Kmart, Sam’s Club, Kroger, Duane Reade, HEB, Meijer, Publix, Randall’s, Safeway, and more. No matter where you fill your prescription, RxSaver can help you get good savings off the retail price of your Rx medication.

How Much Does RxSaver Cost?
RxSaver is free to use. There are no membership fees or sign in required.

How Does the RxSaver App Work?
It’s simple and easy. Just install the app, search for your prescription medication, edit the dosage as needed, and get the coupon you want. Using the “Save Med” button you can keep your rx medication information handy for quick price checks anytime.

Can I Use Rx Coupons With Insurance or Without Insurance?
RxSaver can be used by anyone who is insured, underinsured, or without insurance coverage. If the RxSaver coupon offers a better price than your health care insurance copay, simply use the coupon instead of your insurance for the prescription. Lower your out-of-pocket costs and feel good about your Rx savings.

RxSaver is NOT INSURANCE. RxSaver coupons cannot be combined with federal/state-funded health care programs like Medicaid or Medicare.

Can I use RxSaver at the pharmacy drive-thru? What about delivery?
RxSaver is your single savings solution for home delivery, drive-thru, and pick-up from your local pharmacy. Just call ahead to give the pharmacist the coupon information over the phone, or read the codes at the drive-thru. RxSaver also allows you to compare drug prices between local and online pharmacies with free home delivery.

Do RxSaver Coupons Work on Refills?
Good news, RxSaver coupons never expire and you can keep the coupon on file at the pharmacy for all your refills. However, prescription prices can change over time. Searching for your medication through the RxSaver app is the best way to see current coupon prices.

How is the RxSaver App Different from Rx Discount Cards?
Paper Rx discount cards can get lost, but the RxSaver app is always free and easy to access on your device. The RxSaver app is a digital rx discount card that is always available when you need it and is the single easiest way to save at the pharmacy. The RxSaver app offers instant rx coupons on demand.

Does RxSaver Work For Rx Pet Meds?
If your pet needs prescription drugs, you don’t have to pay full-price! RxSaver offers free coupons for pet meds that have human equivalents, which can be easily filled at local pharmacies. Ask your vet before filling your pet's next prescription.

» How it works:
1. Set up a habit
2. Tell HabitBull how you went for a day
3. Watch your daily streak increase

Habits are no more than routines which you perform subconsciously. To build one - train yourself. To break one, find another one which is similar, yet different and nicer, and repeat it until it sticks.

To assist you with this HabitBull lets you set reminders for each habit and displays them on days when you need to be successful. It can also be used as a calendar planning tool or checklist, but also as a very effective repeating reminder (e.g. to drink water every 2 hours).

HabitBull does feel a little like a game in which you compete with yourself. The task is to get a long streak for the habit you are working on by covering your goals. The longer the better. It takes a couple of months to fully build a new routine, so don't give up - it takes time and if you are consistent it will work; even if it takes a few attempts.

There are many things which you may want to improve. HabitBull can be used as a planner in building habits like taking your pills regularly, exercise, or keep to a diet. It can also be used as a helper for people suffering from memory problems. As for your vices, HabitBull can be a useful goal tracking tool, or a smart notebook, to assist you while breaking bad habits like nail-biting, drinking alcohol and even improving your dating skills.
