name: ZIEL: Habit Tracker & Streaks
description:
Most productivity apps are really good at making you feel productive.

Smooth UI.
Nice animations.
Streaks that somehow never break.

Meanwhile, your actual life doesn’t change.

Ziel exists because of that gap.

It’s not here to motivate you.
It’s here to reflect what you actually did.

CORE IDEA

If you don’t complete your day, your streak breaks.

No partial credit.
No “I’ll fix it later.”
No editing yesterday to protect your ego.

Once the day ends, it’s locked.

You don’t get to negotiate with it.
You don’t get to rewrite it.

It simply shows the truth.

WHY THIS EXISTS

Most productivity systems are designed for engagement.

They keep you opening the app.
They reward you constantly.
They make sure you feel like you’re progressing.

Even when you’re not.

Ziel is built differently.

It prioritizes accuracy over comfort.
Consistency over motivation.
Reality over perception.

Because progress only happens when you stop lying to yourself.

WHAT MAKES IT DIFFERENT

24-hour lock system
When a day ends, it becomes read-only. No backdating. No fixing missed tasks. No retroactive wins.

Strict streak system
You either completed your day or you didn’t. There’s no partial success masking failure.

No gamification
No XP. No coins. No artificial reward loops. No systems designed to keep you hooked without improving you.

Fully offline
No account required. No cloud sync. No tracking. Your data stays entirely on your device.

Minimal design
No distractions. No clutter. No unnecessary features. Everything exists for a reason.

WHAT YOU CAN DO

Track habits
Build daily routines and hold yourself accountable to them.

Manage tasks
Create and complete tasks with a clear yes or no outcome.

Write a journal
Capture your thoughts, reflections, and daily experiences.

Plan your schedule
Use calendar-based planning to structure your future days.

View reports
Look back at your past performance without filters or edits.

Set reminders
Stay aware of what needs to be done without being overwhelmed.

WHAT THIS APP WILL NOT DO

It won’t motivate you with quotes.
It won’t reward you for showing up halfway.
It won’t protect your streak.
It won’t let you rewrite missed days.
It won’t pretend everything is fine when it isn’t.

THE PHILOSOPHY

Most people don’t struggle because they lack tools.

They struggle because their tools are too forgiving.

When you can always fix yesterday,
you never truly fail.

And when you never truly fail,
you never truly improve.

Ziel removes that escape.

It replaces flexibility with clarity.
It replaces comfort with accountability.

TRIAL AND ACCESS

The app starts with a free trial that gives full access to all features.

After that, some limits apply unless premium is unlocked.

There are no ads.
There is no tracking.
There are no hidden systems working against you.

WHO THIS IS FOR

People who are tired of:

Starting over every week
Feeling productive without real results
Relying on motivation instead of discipline
Using systems that are easy to cheat

People who want a system that is:

Simple
Strict
Honest

A SMALL WARNING

This app can feel harsh.

That’s intentional.

Because progress is not built on how things feel.

It’s built on what you actually do, consistently, over time.

If you want something that makes you feel productive, this isn’t it.

If you want something that shows you the truth, try it.

Key App features:

* Real-time processing - The receipt scanning process is quick. It will save & organize the extracted data immediately on the cloud. You will not need the receipt after scanning it, as your data is processed in real time.

* Security - Our integration with Google Drive is completely secure. There is no external interference from ads. Foreceipt does not allow any data mining and your data is only accessible to you.

* Monthly Budget Planner - You can track your spending, income, & balances monthly. Create categories to manage your financial reporting & budget. This app is a bookkeeper that’ll make money-saving & bank account reconciliation trouble-free.

* For all currencies - Expenses can be recorded in any currency. Use the live exchange rate feature in the app, which allows you to manage your bills on the go, across the world, in whichever currency you require.

* Cloud-Based - Foreceipt saves data on the cloud, which makes it accessible from any device at any time. You don’t have to deal with the hassle of storing your receipts for months.

* Offline Access - Saved data can be viewed without internet access. The app will automatically sync & organize with the cloud the next time you’re online.

* Cross-Device Accessibility - The app can be logged into on multiple devices (Android, iOS, & web) and will keep the data synchronized. Upon making any changes in the app, the updated data will be visible on all devices. Auto synchronization makes Foreceipt a receipt tracker app for both a family or a business.

* Charts & Grids - View data charts to get an overview of your expenses, savings, & current balance. You can pick the categories and the format you want to view your finances in.

Foreceipt is the most sophisticated and advanced receipt organizer app you will find to scan, track & manage your money & expenses. Organize finance reports, budgets & track your tax refund on any smartphone, tablet or desktop. Make Foreceipt your personal bookkeeper. Download the app now and make bookkeeping a breeze.

name: Allday HVAC Calc
description:
The application can be useful for HVAC engineers and contains 3 modules.

Psychrometric Calculator - this module determines air properties based on input values such as dry-bulb temperature, wet-bulb temperature, and relative humidity. It provides results like humidity ratio, specific volume, enthalpy, and vapor pressure in both SI and IP units.

Pipe Calculator - this module is used to calculate velocity and pressure loss in pipelines and to select pipeline diameters for a given maximum velocity and pressure loss. The module supports interdependent calculations of flow rate, heat load, and fluid temperatures: when any three of these parameters are specified, the fourth is calculated automatically. It can also be used as a reference for heat transfer fluid properties and pipe characteristics.

Duct Calculator - the module is used to calculate the speed and pressure loss in round, rectangular and oval air ducts when moving wet or dry air through them, as well as to select their sections for a given maximum speed and maximum pressure loss. Additionally, the heating or cooling power is calculated for a given air flow rate, or reverse calculations: air flow rate for a given power; temperature of incoming or outgoing air for a given power and flow rate. It can also be used as a reference material for determining the properties of wet and dry air at different pressures and temperatures.

Also in the description sections are the reference formulas by which the calculations are made.

name: HVAC Airflow CFM Calculator

Temperature Delta Method — CFM from BTU load and supply/return temperature difference
Duct Velocity Method — CFM from duct size (round or rectangular) and air velocity (FPM)
Sensible Heat Method — CFM from sensible cooling/heating capacity and temperature delta
Total Heat Method — CFM from total heat load and enthalpy difference

Dry Bulb + Dew Point — From condensation temperature (moisture indicator)

Dry Bulb Temperature (°F) — Sensible temperature measurement

Dew Point Temperature (°F) — Moisture content and condensation risk

Humidity Ratio (grains/lb) — Absolute moisture quantity for dehumidification
Enthalpy (BTU/lb) — Total heat content for system load calculations
Specific Volume (ft³/lb) — Air density for ductwork and ventilation

UNDERSTANDING RESULTS:
Superheat — Temperature rise above saturation on low side. Normal 10-20°F TXV, 15-25°F fixed orifice. Low indicates overcharge; high indicates undercharge or low airflow.

Green — Normal charge, optimal operation

name: Pomodoro Timer
description:
Bring structure to your workflow by utilising time blocking technique.


Time blocking is an effective strategy for using time wisely and achieving greater results. Blocking out time for specific activities allows you to focus on one task at a time, limit distractions and procrastination.


It's really simple to use:


1. Define your tasks at hand, make a task list.

2. Define a block of time during which you will eliminate all distractions and give all your focus to your tasks. Start the timer and work.

3. Take frequent breaks. Regular breaks are conducive to greater productivity and concentration. During these breaks take a breath of fresh air, do some push-ups, stretch or anything else that helps you to restore your power. Your body will thank you.

4. Repeat this work/break cycle and take a longer breaks when you feel you need to.

1. are newly diagnosed or looking to understand their ADHD better: we provide psycho-education and guidance for you to understand ADHD & how it impacts your life
2. have concrete executive function skills they’d like to improve on and are looking for guidance to follow through: we provide the critical knowledge, resources, guidance, support, and accountability so that you actually implement the changes (routines, skills, tools) that will help you reach your goals
3. know they can achieve more and aren’t living at their potential: we use an ACT-based methodology to help you identify your values and help you live in line with them

Our ADHD coaches partner with you to co-design a plan to achieve your goals. You'll experiment with strategies on a weekly basis to implement a routine fit specifically for YOU. Our program has been designed off science-backed methods in partnership with NYU, UC Berkeley, and UCSF.

- Attend weekly 1:1 check-ins with your coach
- Personalized plan each week catered to you
- Experiment with tailored skills, strategies, and routines
- Text-based accountability check-ins throughout the week from your coach
- Learn ADHD skills and tips through bite-sized learning modules

The biggest value we’ve heard from our members are:

- An expert ADHD coach that knows ADHD inside out and understands them
- An accountability partner to hold them to what they said they’d do
- Someone to help them break down big tasks to feel less overwhelmed
- Guidance to navigate the sea of content and resources out there
- Personalized positive reinforcement, support and celebration of the little things
- Weekly cadence to make baby steps for changes in their life
- An affordable alternative to traditional ADHD coaching that fits into their life

Our coaches are specialized in taking an ADHD-adapted approach to coaching and are skilled at helping you navigate life’s ups and downs. Not sure if you’re in the right place? Our members come to use and are working on:

- Understanding their ADHD
- Feeling they’re not living up to their full potential
- Goal setting & habit building
- Creating routines & schedules
- Feelings of overwhelm, paralysis, and inability to turn brain off
- Issues with self-esteem and negative self-talk
- Inability to focus during working hours
- Holding themselves accountable to changes, challenging “excuse” thoughts
- Task initiation
- Being more productive

Most of our members have ADHD but you don’t need to be formally diagnosed to use Shimmer. We help all sorts of individuals with ADHD-related symptoms like executive function challenges, goal-setting, and living a fuller life!

name: Diem: Big Group Chat Energy
description:
AI Search, Community Chats

Welcome to Diem! We’re building your new front door to the internet.

Diem is a search-engine-meets-social-network designed first for girls, women, and LGBTQIA+ folks. You can search the internet with Diem AI and find answers to anything life throws at you. “How do I get over a friend breakup? What’s the best way to negotiate salary? My boyfriend follows models on Instagram—is that a red flag?” Diem is here to help.

Our platform is also full of novel, collective knowledge from people all over the world. You can socialize your search to start conversations, discover a network of communities, connect over shared experiences and browse trending topics.

Joining Diem means showing up with no judgment and immersing yourself in the candid, funny, authentic, important, supportive, outrageous, honest, and wholesome questions of other Diemers, which span everything from birth control to friendship, sexuality to pop culture, parenting to relationships, money to reproductive health, career to books, and so much more. Diem feels more like searching for answers in the girls’ bathroom than spiraling alone on the internet.

Here’s what you can find in the app today:

Diem AI-powered search

Ask Diem AI, our AI-powered search tool, your questions! Our search engine is designed to be less bias than other models. You can think of Diem AI as your most knowledgeable Virgo “big sister” who lives in your back pocket. Diem AI draws from across the internet and the collective wisdom of Diemers to generate you a speedy answer. When you ask Diem AI you’ll receive a short summary answer, community sources (previous, related conversations in Diem), community spaces, web pages, Reddit threads and TikTok videos. You can dive in to these search results OR you can post your search to the community feed to get real-time feedback from people who’ve been there.

Diem AI Lenses

You can now ask questions of leading experts and your fave creators in Diem. Ask their Lens anything and your search result will feature their opinions & content from across the internet.

Discover thousands of authentic conversations

From awkward sex questions to wholesome big sisterly advice or navigating life’s highs and lows, Diem is full of the collective knowledge of girls, women, and LGBTQIA+ folks in over 100 countries.There’s no judgment here and you’ll feel that very quickly.

Post anonymously or under a pseudonym

We think of the anonymous feature as a confidence booster. Sometimes posting ‘taboo’ questions or personal stories publicly can be nerve-wracking, so this feature is designed to make you feel more comfortable while getting the advice you need.

Community Spaces

Community Spaces are micro communities that are also discoverable when related questions are searched via Diem AI. A few currently live: Am I wrong?, Big Sis Advice (BSA) and Is this Normal…? (ITN) We’re still early in building out Spaces and you can request additional Spaces or host your own.

Creating Posts

If you have a longer story, recommendation or advice to offer you can click the + button on your Discover feed and type out all your stories or wisdom. These posts will be discovered via the search engine and in Diemer’s discovery feeds.

Upvoting & Bookmarking

See a post or response you want to save for later or give some love to, click to bookmark, “heart” or upvote it!

Safety & Privacy First

Safety & moderation are our top priority at Diem. See something, say something! We have distributed moderation—if you report something, we review it, ensuring there’s no violation of the community culture. We also take your privacy very seriously—whatever you search is your business.

We’re still early in our journey to build Diem into your new ‘front door’ to the internet, if you have any problems or ideas for the app, get support at help@askdiem.com.

Happy Dieming!

The Gold Standard FODMAP Diet Plan

Based on 15+ years of scientific research, studies show the low FODMAP diet is effective at reducing IBS symptoms in up to 75% of people.

The low FODMAP diet helps manage digestive symptoms, including: Bloating, Abdominal pain, Diarrhoea, Constipation, Cramps, Excessive Gas, and other digestive complaints.

The Shortest Path to Getting Results

People typically feel relief within 10-14 days of starting a low FODMAP plan. IBS Coach is the complete FODMAP diet app for beginners - guiding you through a step-by-step plan, without the stress of figuring it out on your own.

Low FODMAP isn't a forever diet. It's a temporary, structured plan to calm your digestion, identify your unique triggers, and get back to normal living.

Have you been told to try a low FODMAP diet?

You might have been given a FODMAP food list and left to get on with it. Attempting the FODMAP diet with a simple food list when you need a guided plan is the reason people fail the elimination phase or get stuck eating low FODMAP forever.

The Plan in Three Steps

1. Calm your gut: Get your digestion under control with our guided low FODMAP elimination phase.
2. Test your triggers: Safely test your tolerance to specific foods to identify your trigger ingredients. Everyone is different. Don't skip this step.
3. Get back to normal living: Knowing your triggers means you're in control and can enjoy meals again.

What's Included: Your Complete FODMAP Plan

Built with dietitians and doctors, your gold standard FODMAP plan includes:

- Meal Planner & Automated Shopping Lists: Personalised weekly plans with shopping lists built for you.
- 100+ Dietitian-Approved Low FODMAP Recipes: Breakfasts, lunches, dinners, desserts and snacks — with Gluten-Free, Dairy-Free, Lactose-Free, Vegan & Vegetarian options.
- A–Z FODMAP Ingredient Database: Look up any ingredient and know instantly if it's safe, caution or avoid.
- The SOS Flare-Up Guide: Know exactly what to do when symptoms strike.
- Comprehensive Symptom Tracker: Log symptoms, add your own notes, and spot the patterns behind your triggers.
- Progress Reports: Track and monitor your improvement over time.
- Knowledge Bank: Bite-sized education to understand your gut and stay in control.

Daily Science-Backed Education & Practical Tips

As well as the complete FODMAP plan, IBS Coach helps you understand and improve your digestion:

- Diet education: learn about FODMAPs and how ingredients trigger symptoms
- Stress management: science-backed techniques to calm non-dietary triggers

Everyone is different, and your personalised plan helps you take control of your IBS. Join over 100,000 people discovering meals that work for their gut. Get back to living your life again.

LOW — Safe for a Low FODMAP diet.

HIGH — Likely to trigger IBS symptoms, bloating, or digestive discomfort.
Deep Ingredient Analysis

We show you exactly why a food is safe or not — naming the specific FODMAP types (fructans, GOS, lactose, excess fructose, polyols) and which ingredients are the culprits. You actually learn to read labels on your own.
Personal Safe Food Lists

Save your go-to safe products and organize them into custom lists. Your scanned photos are analyzed securely and never permanently stored.

IBS (Irritable Bowel Syndrome) management

SIBO (Small Intestinal Bacterial Overgrowth) diet support

Crohn's disease and digestive condition management

The Low FODMAP elimination and reintroduction phases

Food intolerance and sensitivity identification

Finding fast bloating and gas relief through safe eating

Identifying Gluten-Free and Dairy-Free options easily

Building a personalized gut health meal plan

People newly diagnosed with IBS who are starting the elimination phase, experienced FODMAP dieters who want a faster way to check products at the store, and anyone managing a chronic digestive condition who is tired of second-guessing every meal.
Take control of your gut health today. FODMAP Scanner is the daily companion that turns grocery shopping and cooking from a source of anxiety into something you can feel genuinely confident about.

📉PERSONALISED TRACKER
Add custom foods and symptoms that are personal to you and track them together with the others. Endive knows recipes and breaks them down into ingredients to make IBS tracking faster and more efficient.

If you have a condition you know about, but want to optimise your diet to help improve your symptoms, Endive helps you keep track of what you have eaten and how you feel, both physically and psychologically. This allows you to learn how your body reacts to different foods 🥑, or which triggers (e.g. anxiety, depression) are causing you symptoms.

📊WIDE RANGING TRACKER

Endive helps you manage conditions such as:

✅ IBS (Irritable Bowel Syndrome)

✅ Bloating, heartburn, and many other digestive conditions

name: FoodView: Easy food diary
description:
FoodView aims to make keeping a photo food diary as quick & simple as possible. There is no calorie tracking, barcode scanning or manual data entry.

We hope that keeping a food diary will help you be more aware of what you're eating & drinking and help you short-circuit habits that you'd like to break.

Photos can be saved online and shared with a link. This can also be used to transfer photos to another device. Photos can also be viewed, backed up and restored via Wi-Fi.

This can come in handy when discussing nutrition with healthcare professionals. By quickly giving them an accurate picture of your food intake you will hopefully be better placed to get useful advice and spend less appointment time answering food intake questions.

There are no ads & we care about your privacy - photos are not sent anywhere unless you share them. In the future premium features may be added - such as securely sharing photos via an online portal and getting advice from dietitians.
